title: Longitudinal effects of ambient artificial intelligence scribe use on documentation burden and financial productivity in primary care: a quasi-experimental study.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To investigate the longitudinal effects of an ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribe use in primary care on outcomes related to documentation time, note writing patterns, and clinician financial productivity. We conducted a quasi-experimental study with an interrupted time-series design to ascertain the effect of AI scribe use on note writing time, time outside of scheduled hours (TOSH), pajama time (5:30PM-7:00aM), note length, note closure <24 h, and work relative value units (wRVU). For each primary care clinician (physician, advanced practice provider), date of initial access was day 0; each measure was calculated for 150 days prior (pre-period) and after (post-period) day zero. Two hundred and twenty clinicians (mean age = 43.7, 70.9% females; 56.4% physicians) from 36 clinics, conducting 314 845 patient encounters were included. Compared to the pre-period, there was 7% decrease in note writing time at day 0 (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 0.93, 95% credible interval [CI] [0.89, 0.98]), increasing to 16% decrease by day 150 (IRR 0.84, 95% CI [0.82, 0.87]). There was no change in pajama time, TOSH, or wRVU at day 0; however, at day 150, there was a 19% decrease in pajama time (0.81, 95% CI [0.73, 0.90]), 13% decrease in TOSH (0.87, 95% CI [0.77, 0.98]), and a 2% increase in wRVU (1.02, 95% CI [1.01, 1.04]). At day 0, there was a 5% increase in note closures (1.05, 95% CI [1.02, 1.08]), with no difference to pre-period levels by day 150. There were no changes in note length at day 0 or day 150. There were persistent changes in AI scribe use measures over time as clinicians situated these tools within their workflows.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 研究在基层医疗中使用环境人工智能（AI）记录员（ambient AI scribe）对文档记录时间、病历书写模式和临床医生财务生产力相关结局的纵向影响。我们开展了一项采用中断时间序列设计的准实验研究，以确定AI记录员使用对病历书写时间、计划外时间（TOSH）、睡衣时间（pajama time，下午5:30至上午7:00）、病历长度、24小时内病历关闭以及工作相对价值单位（wRVU）的影响。对于每位基层医疗临床医生（医师、高级实践提供者），首次访问日期为第0天；每项指标均在第0天前150天（前期）和后150天（后期）计算。共纳入来自36家诊所的220名临床医生（平均年龄=43.7岁，70.9%为女性；56.4%为医师），其进行了314 845次患者就诊。与前期相比，第0天病历书写时间下降7%（发生率比[IRR] 0.93，95%可信区间[CI] [0.89, 0.98]），到第150天增至下降16%（IRR 0.84，95% CI [0.82, 0.87]）。第0天睡衣时间、TOSH或wRVU无变化；然而到第150天，睡衣时间下降19%（0.81，95% CI [0.73, 0.90]），TOSH下降13%（0.87，95% CI [0.77, 0.98]），wRVU增加2%（1.02，95% CI [1.01, 1.04]）。第0天病历关闭增加5%（1.05，95% CI [1.02, 1.08]），到第150天与前期水平无差异。第0天或第150天病历长度均无变化。随着临床医生将这些工具置于其工作流程中，AI记录员使用指标随时间出现持续变化。

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Spatial transcriptomics (STs) measures gene expression while retaining the location of transcripts or cells within tissue sections. Unlike bulk RNA sequencing, which averages expression across cell populations, and single-cell RNA sequencing, which generally requires tissue dissociation, ST links molecular profiles to tissue architecture. This spatial information supports the analysis of tissue heterogeneity, cellular organization, and potential intercellular interactions. The spatially resolved nature of ST has unlocked diverse applications in fields such as cancer, neuroscience, reproductive biology, and plant biology. In parallel, the development of publicly accessible databases and repositories has facilitated large-scale, multi-cohort comparisons and benchmarking. The rapid expansion and increasing complexity of these datasets have driven the adoption of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. These computational tools support a range of tasks, including data pre-processing, image segmentation, spatial domain identification, and pattern recognition. Moreover, they are instrumental in integrative multi-omics analyses and predictive modeling. This AI-focused review provides necessary background on ST technologies and databases and evaluates the use of statistical, ML, and DL methods across the analytical workflow, from image and sequencing-data preprocessing to spatial analysis and LLM-assisted interpretation. We compile key resources related to datasets, AI-driven analytical frameworks, and ST data analysis pipelines, and discuss current challenges, limitations, and future directions for AI-based tools in spatial omics.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 空间转录组学（STs）在保留组织切片内转录本或细胞位置的同时测量基因表达。与对细胞群体表达取平均的批量RNA测序，以及通常需要组织解离的单细胞RNA测序不同，ST将分子谱与组织结构联系起来。这种空间信息支持对组织异质性、细胞组织方式以及潜在细胞间相互作用的分析。ST的空间分辨特性已在癌症、神经科学、生殖生物学和植物生物学等领域开启了多样化应用。与此同时，可公开访问的数据库和存储库的发展促进了大规模、多队列比较和基准测试。这些数据集的快速扩展和日益增加的复杂性推动了机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）和人工智能（AI）技术的采用。这些计算工具支持一系列任务，包括数据预处理、图像分割、空间域识别和模式识别。此外，它们在整合性多组学分析和预测建模中发挥重要作用。这篇以AI为重点的综述提供了ST技术和数据库的必要背景，并评估了统计、ML和DL方法在整个分析流程中的使用，从图像和测序数据预处理到空间分析以及LLM辅助解释。我们汇编了与数据集、AI驱动分析框架和ST数据分析流程相关的关键资源，并讨论了基于AI的工具在空间组学中的当前挑战、局限性和未来方向。

title: Toward integrated multimodal artificial intelligence in bone marrow examination: current state and open challenges.

abstract: [Blood research] Bone marrow (BM) examinations are intrinsically multimodal: hematopathologists integrate peripheral blood, aspirate cytomorphology, trephine histology, flow cytometry, cytogenetics, and molecular genetics data into a single interpretation. Because WHO-HAEM5 and ICC 2022 define entities through integrated morphological, immunophenotypic, cytogenetic, and molecular criteria, multimodal diagnostic reasoning embedded in a procedural workflow, not isolated image classification, represents the appropriate target for the use of artificial intelligence (AI). We review the existing research on integrated multimodal AI systems for BM examination by classifying these systems into three categories: mature single-modality tools; systems that perform cross-modal prediction, in which one modality is estimated from another; and genuine multimodal fusion systems, in which several modalities are jointly ingested by a single model. Evidence is stronger at the single-modality level, where deep learning approaches expert performance in aspirate cytology, trephine histology, and flow cytometry assessments, and the first Food and Drug Administration (FDA) De Novo-authorized all-digital bone marrow aspirate (BMA) application has defined a new device category. On the other hand, while cross-modal prediction is rapidly expanding, genuine multimodal fused systems that jointly ingest matched morphology, flow, molecular, and clinical data to yield unified guideline-aligned recommendations remain unrealized. Direct head-to-head evidence is sparse and endpoint-dependent; nevertheless, the lack of demonstrated superiority over the strongest single-modality comparator does not automatically imply the absence of benefits. The dominant obstacles are fusion of heterogeneous modalities with missing data, absence of large paired multi-institutional datasets and harmonized nomenclature, class imbalances, batch-effect-driven generalization failures, immature explainability, uncertainty quantification, and regulatory pathways. Nevertheless, integrated multimodal AI systems for BM examinations have entered a promising early translational phase, and the field should aim to pursue integration using paired datasets, explicit fusion architectures, calibrated abstention-aware models, and staged prospective validation.
zh_abstract: [血液研究] 骨髓（bone marrow, BM）检查本质上是多模态的：血液病理学家将外周血、抽吸物细胞形态学、环钻组织学、流式细胞术、细胞遗传学和分子遗传学数据整合为单一解释。由于 WHO-HAEM5 和 ICC 2022 通过整合形态学、免疫表型、细胞遗传学和分子标准来定义实体，嵌入流程化工作流中的多模态诊断推理，而非孤立的图像分类，才是使用人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的适当目标。我们综述了用于 BM 检查的整合多模态 AI 系统的现有研究，并将这些系统分为三类：成熟的单模态工具；执行跨模态预测的系统，即从一种模态估计另一种模态；以及真正的多模态融合系统，即由单一模型联合摄取多种模态。证据在单模态层面更强，其中深度学习方法在抽吸物细胞学、环钻组织学和流式细胞术评估中接近专家表现，并且首个获美国食品药品监督管理局（Food and Drug Administration, FDA）De Novo 授权的全数字化骨髓抽吸物（bone marrow aspirate, BMA）应用已定义了一个新的器械类别。另一方面，虽然跨模态预测正在迅速扩展，但真正联合摄取匹配的形态学、流式、分子和临床数据以产生统一的、符合指南的建议的多模态融合系统仍未实现。直接头对头证据稀少且取决于终点；然而，缺乏优于最强单模态对照的已证明优势并不自动意味着不存在获益。主要障碍包括异质性模态与缺失数据的融合、缺乏大型配对多机构数据集和统一命名、类别不平衡、批次效应驱动的泛化失败、可解释性和不确定性量化不成熟以及监管路径。尽管如此，用于 BM 检查的整合多模态 AI 系统已进入有前景的早期转化阶段，该领域应致力于使用配对数据集、明确的融合架构、经校准且具备弃权感知的模型以及分阶段前瞻性验证来推进整合。

abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] Large language model (LLM)-based generative AI offers the promise of responsive health information for patients and carers but presents ethical and legal challenges when used outside clinical oversight. This review maps these considerations for patients accessing information on long-term conditions in non-clinical settings. Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched databases (MEDLINE, CINAHL, EMBASE, and Web of Science) between April and May 2025. The review synthesises 24 cross-sectional studies regarding patient-facing LLMs, excluding clinician-support tools. Results indicate that LLMs perform well on general topics but struggle with specialised information, often generating complex responses with unreliable citations. Ethical concerns highlight inaccuracy, insufficient empathy, and the potential exacerbation of health inequalities, while analyses of legal challenges focus mainly on liability and consent. We conclude that current technical limitations and regulatory gaps regarding device classification and safety obligations could pose risks to patients. Consequently, stakeholders must establish clear accountability frameworks, and LLMs should currently function only as supplementary tools rather than replacements for expert clinical advice. Further research into the use of agent-based LLM architectures, where specialised LLM agents collaborate to verify information, reason symbolically, and interface with patient health records under strict data governance, may provide the solution to the current limitations of LLMs.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] 基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式AI为患者和照护者提供及时响应健康信息的希望，但在临床监督之外使用时带来伦理和法律挑战。本综述梳理了患者在非临床环境中获取长期疾病信息时的这些考量。遵循PRISMA指南，我们于2025年4月至5月检索了数据库（MEDLINE、CINAHL、EMBASE和Web of Science）。本综述综合了24项关于面向患者的LLM的横断面研究，排除了临床医生支持工具。结果表明，LLM在一般主题上表现良好，但在专业信息方面存在困难，常生成复杂回答且引用不可靠。伦理担忧突出不准确、共情不足以及健康不平等可能加剧，而对法律挑战的分析主要集中于责任和知情同意。我们得出结论，当前在设备分类和安全义务方面的技术局限和监管空白可能给患者带来风险。因此，利益相关者必须建立明确的问责框架，且LLM目前应仅作为补充工具发挥作用，而不是替代专家临床建议。进一步研究使用基于智能体（agent-based）的LLM架构——其中专门的LLM智能体协作验证信息、进行符号推理，并在严格数据治理下与患者健康记录对接——可能为当前LLM的局限性提供解决方案。

abstract: [Current opinion in obstetrics & gynecology] Midurethral sling (MUS) surgery is the standard procedure for stress urinary incontinence, offering favorable long-term outcomes. Despite its success, postoperative voiding dysfunction - manifesting as urinary retention, elevated post-void residuals (PVRs), slow or weak stream, hesitancy, or the need for prolonged catheterization - remains a clinically significant complication that is difficult to predict using traditional risk stratification. Conventional methods, including history, physical examination, PVR measurement, and selective urodynamics, provide limited individualized predictive power and fail to integrate the complex interplay of patient, anatomical, and surgical factors. Artificial intelligence and machine learning offer a promising approach to addressing this gap by analyzing multidimensional datasets to forecast individualized risk and guide perioperative management. While artificial intelligence applications in pelvic floor surgery have demonstrated utility in predicting general surgical outcomes, validated models specifically targeting post-MUS voiding dysfunction are lacking. Development of such predictive tools will require high-quality multicenter datasets, careful algorithm selection, and validation. Integrating artificial intelligence into clinical practice has the potential to enhance preoperative counseling, support shared decision-making, optimize surgical planning, and ultimately improve patient outcomes. This perspective highlights the unmet need for predictive modeling of voiding dysfunction after MUS, outlines the promise of artificial intelligence, and emphasizes the importance of responsible implementation.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in obstetrics & gynecology] 中段尿道悬吊术（MUS）是压力性尿失禁的标准手术，具有较好的长期结局。尽管其取得成功，术后排尿功能障碍——表现为尿潴留、排尿后残余尿量（PVRs）升高、尿流缓慢或无力、排尿踌躇，或需要长期导尿——仍是一种具有临床意义的并发症，且难以通过传统风险分层进行预测。传统方法，包括病史、体格检查、PVR测量和选择性尿动力学检查，提供的个体化预测能力有限，且未能整合患者、解剖和手术因素之间复杂的相互作用。人工智能和机器学习通过分析多维数据集来预测个体化风险并指导围手术期管理，为解决这一缺口提供了一种有前景的方法。尽管人工智能在盆底手术中的应用已显示出预测一般手术结局的效用，但专门针对MUS术后排尿功能障碍的经过验证的模型仍然缺乏。开发此类预测工具将需要高质量的多中心数据集、谨慎的算法选择和验证。将人工智能整合到临床实践中，有可能加强术前咨询、支持共同决策、优化手术规划，并最终改善患者结局。本观点文章强调了MUS术后排尿功能障碍预测建模方面未满足的需求，概述了人工智能的前景，并强调了负责任实施的重要性。

title: The Model Knows Better: Defending Medical Multi-Agent Systems Against Prompt Injection

abstract: Medical multi-agent systems, in which LLM agents discuss a case, are increasingly studied for clinical decision support. Prompt injection, text that an attacker adds to a model's input, can manipulate LLMs into wrong decisions. How it affects these systems, and how to protect them, remains unclear. Across two systems, two model families and three benchmarks, a single injected passage succeeds in up to 61% of cases, and collaboration does not consistently protect against it. Existing defenses help only partly: they miss injections that look like ordinary clinical text. Yet when asked to check the injected text against the patient's findings, a model that followed the injection usually rejects it. We therefore propose a training-free defense that verifies the clinical judgments behind the system's decision. Following clinical practice, it separates the patient's findings from clinical judgments, such as diagnoses, recommendations and instructions, and checks each judgment against the findings alone, so the decision rests only on supported judgments. Our defense outperforms all baselines on every benchmark, lowering attack success on MedQA to 4-7% while maintaining accuracy on cases without an attack, and remains effective with a medical model and against defense-aware and adaptive attacks.
zh_abstract: 医学多智能体系统——即LLM智能体讨论一个病例——正越来越多地被研究用于临床决策支持。提示注入，即攻击者添加到模型输入中的文本，可以操纵LLM做出错误决策。它如何影响这些系统以及如何保护这些系统仍不清楚。在两个系统、两个模型家族和三个基准上，单段注入文本在高达61%的病例中成功，并且协作并不能始终防止其影响。现有防御仅能部分起作用：它们漏掉看起来像普通临床文本的注入。然而，当要求将注入文本与患者检查发现进行核对时，遵循了注入的模型通常会拒绝它。因此，我们提出一种免训练防御，用于验证系统决策背后的临床判断。遵循临床实践，它将患者的检查发现与临床判断（如诊断、建议和指令）分开，并仅依据检查发现来核对每个判断，从而使决策只依赖于有支持的判断。我们的防御在每个基准上都优于所有基线，将MedQA上的攻击成功率降至4-7%，同时保持无攻击病例上的准确性，并且在医学模型下以及面对感知防御的攻击和自适应攻击时仍然有效。

title: Trajectory-Guided Steering: Mitigating Spurious Feature Bias in Clinical Classification
zh_title: 轨迹引导纠偏：缓解临床分类的虚假特征偏倚
summary: 利用模型预测轨迹决定是否纠偏，在i2b2的16项临床分类任务上修正17.7%错误、仅破坏1.3%正确预测。
key_points: 临床笔记替换单个性别词可改变53.5%无关诊断
提出轨迹引导纠偏TGS，无需反事实数据
16项i2b2任务净收益为正，超参下稳定
reason: 新方法+多任务基线对比，证据限于预印本与公开数据集
abstract: Large language models rely on spurious features in clinical classification: swapping a single gender token in clinical notes alters gender-irrelevant diagnoses in up to 53.5% of cases. Existing inference-time corrections either need counterfactual data built around the specific spurious feature or behave unpredictably. We observe that how a model's preference between answers evolves across layers, its prediction trajectory, indicates for each document whether a correction is likely to help. We propose Trajectory-Guided Steering (TGS), which decides from the trajectory alone whether to correct each prediction and in which direction, with no counterfactual data and no knowledge of the spurious feature. On 16 clinical classification tasks from i2b2, TGS fixes 17.7% of errors while breaking only 1.3% of correct predictions and stays net-positive across all tested hyperparameter settings; all baselines are net-negative or near zero. The same corrections reduce reliance on the spurious feature: on the most affected diseases, gender-swap inconsistency falls sharply (hypertension 53.5% -> 38.0%, diabetes 35.1% -> 21.5%). Applying the correction to every document instead raises breaks on correct positive predictions from 0.1% to 6.4%, so per-document selection is essential. TGS also transfers to three model families and three other clinical and biomedical datasets.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型在临床分类中依赖虚假特征：在临床笔记中替换单个性别标记，会使与性别无关的诊断在高达 53.5% 的病例中发生改变。现有的推理时校正要么需要围绕特定虚假特征构建反事实数据，要么表现不可预测。我们观察到，模型在答案之间的偏好如何跨层演变，即其预测轨迹，可指示对于每份文档校正是否可能有益。我们提出轨迹引导干预（Trajectory-Guided Steering, TGS），仅根据轨迹决定是否对每个预测进行校正以及校正方向，无需反事实数据，也不知晓虚假特征。在来自 i2b2 的 16 项临床分类任务上，TGS 修复了 17.7% 的错误，同时仅破坏 1.3% 的正确预测，并且在所有测试的超参数设置下均保持净收益为正；所有基线均为净负或接近零。相同的校正降低了对虚假特征的依赖：在受影响最严重的疾病上，性别替换不一致性大幅下降（高血压 53.5% -> 38.0%，糖尿病 35.1% -> 21.5%）。若对每份文档都应用校正，则正确阳性预测的破坏率从 0.1% 升至 6.4%，因此逐文档选择至关重要。TGS 还可迁移至三个模型家族以及另外三个临床和生物医学数据集。

title: CRUX: Clinical-Text Anchoring for Cross-Institutional CT-Pathology Fusion in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Survival Prediction
zh_title: CRUX：临床文本锚定的跨机构CT-病理融合生存预测
summary: 预印本提出CRUX框架，以生物医学语言模型编码的临床文本作为跨机构不变语义锚，融合CT与病理全切片图像预测NSCLC生存。
key_points: 以临床文本作跨机构语义锚
融合CT与病理全切片图像
针对机构特异性伪影过拟合
reason: 方法有新意且针对跨机构泛化，但为预印本、验证信息有限
abstract: Accurate prognosis in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) benefits from integrating computed tomography (CT) and histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs), which capture complementary macroscopic and microscopic disease characteristics. Fusing these modalities is difficult: their features come from different pretrained foundation-model encoders and lack spatial correspondence, and both are sensitive to institution-specific acquisition and staining, causing multimodal models to overfit site-specific artifacts and generalize poorly. We present CRUX (CRoss-modal Unification via teXt anchoring), a fusion framework that uses clinical text---encoded by a biomedical language model---as an institution-invariant semantic anchor. Because clinical variables follow standardized classification systems, their embeddings occupy a representation space that is consistent across institutions, providing a stable reference frame for aligning heterogeneous imaging features. CRUX introduces a text-mediated cross-modal bridge in which CT- and pathology-derived text-query summaries exchange information within a compact text semantic space through a learnable hub token, avoiding direct image-space cross-attention that would propagate domain-specific artifacts. We evaluate on 2,157 NSCLC patients from five hospitals, holding out one hospital (N=446) entirely for external validation. CRUX attains an external concordance index (C-index) of 0.761, the highest among all unimodal, bimodal, and trimodal configurations. Notably, direct CT-WSI fusion degrades under distribution shift, whereas text anchoring restores and improves cross-institutional generalization. These results indicate that language-model-encoded clinical text is an effective structured prior for robust, generalizable multimodal cancer prognosis.
zh_abstract: 非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的准确预后得益于整合计算机断层扫描（CT）和组织病理全切片图像（WSIs），这些模态捕获互补的大体和微观疾病特征。融合这些模态是困难的：它们的特征来自不同的预训练基础模型编码器，缺乏空间对应关系，且二者均对机构特定的采集与染色敏感，导致多模态模型过拟合机构特异性伪影并泛化不佳。我们提出CRUX（CRoss-modal Unification via teXt anchoring，通过文本锚定的跨模态统一），这是一种融合框架，使用由生物医学语言模型编码的临床文本作为机构不变的语义锚点。由于临床变量遵循标准化分类系统，其嵌入占据在不同机构间一致的表示空间，为对齐异质性影像特征提供稳定参考框架。CRUX引入一种文本介导的跨模态桥接，其中源自CT和病理学的文本查询摘要通过可学习的枢纽标记（hub token）在紧凑的文本语义空间内交换信息，避免会传播域特异性伪影的直接图像空间交叉注意力。我们在来自五家医院的2,157例NSCLC患者上进行评估，完全留出一家医院（N=446）用于外部验证。CRUX达到0.761的外部一致性指数（C-index），在所有单模态、双模态和三模态配置中最高。值得注意的是，直接CT-WSI融合在分布偏移下性能下降，而文本锚定恢复并改善了跨机构泛化。这些结果表明，语言模型编码的临床文本是稳健、可泛化多模态癌症预后的有效结构化先验。

title: CF-NODE: Counterfactual Spatial Node Intervention for Test-Time Adaptation Under Domain Shift, Evaluated Across Five Diabetic Retinopathy Datasets
zh_title: CF-NODE：糖网跨域测试时适应的反事实干预
summary: 提出CF-NODE反事实空间节点干预的测试时适应框架，在五个糖网数据集上评估跨域分级。
key_points: 源域模型跨相机、机构、人群性能显著下降
以空间节点反事实干预替代熵最小化
在五个糖尿病视网膜病变数据集上验证
reason: 多数据集跨域评估有新意，但为预印本且未报告临床结局
abstract: Automated fundus-based diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading can substantially expand screening capacity, but source-trained models degrade sharply across different cameras, clinics, and patient populations. Existing test-time adaptation methods depend on entropy minimization or target information accumulated from image batches and streams. These mechanisms can reinforce confidently incorrect predictions and break down when clinical images arrive independently. We introduce CF-NODE, a novel counterfactual test-time adaptation framework for cross- domain DR grading. Instead of trusting prediction confidence or estimating a target distribution, CF-NODE asks how each prediction responds under a controlled intervention on the evidence supporting it. CF-NODE ranks internal spatial nodes using model-derived attention, feature magnitude, and node-set similarity, progressively attenuates the highest-ranked nodes, and uses the stability of the resulting expected-grade response to apply a bounded calibration of the predicted grade distribution. The framework is fully frozen and adapts every image independently using only geometric views and a fixed source-derived prior, requiring no target-derived information or model updates. We evaluate CF-NODE on five external DR datasets under repeated-seed evaluation against TENT, EATA, SAR, and T3A. CF-NODE outperforms all four methods with statistically significant improvements over the second-best method, improves AUC on every target domain, and attains the highest average AUC and macro-F1, delivering stronger grade discrimination together with more balanced recognition across DR severity levels. These results demonstrate that counterfactual intervention sensitivity provides consistent and deployment-ready domain robustness for single-image clinical inference.
zh_abstract: 基于眼底图像的自动化糖尿病视网膜病变（diabetic retinopathy, DR）分级可大幅扩展筛查能力，但源域训练的模型在不同相机、诊所和患者人群之间会显著退化。现有的测试时自适应方法依赖熵最小化或从图像批次和流中积累的目标信息。这些机制可能强化自信但错误的预测，并在临床图像独立到达时失效。我们提出 CF-NODE，一种用于跨域 DR 分级的新型反事实测试时自适应框架。CF-NODE 不信任预测置信度或估计目标分布，而是询问每个预测在对其支持证据进行受控干预下如何响应。CF-NODE 使用模型衍生的注意力、特征幅度和节点集相似性对内部空间节点排序，逐步衰减排名最高的节点，并使用所得预期分级响应的稳定性对预测分级分布施加有界校准。该框架完全冻结，仅使用几何视图和固定的源域衍生先验即可独立自适应每张图像，无需目标域衍生信息或模型更新。我们在五个外部 DR 数据集上通过重复种子评估，与 TENT、EATA、SAR 和 T3A 进行比较。CF-NODE 优于所有四种方法，相对于第二优方法具有统计学显著改善，在每个目标域上均提高 AUC，并获得最高的平均 AUC 和宏 F1，在提供更强分级判别的同时，在 DR 严重程度级别之间实现更平衡的识别。这些结果表明，反事实干预敏感性为单图像临床推理提供了一致且可部署的域鲁棒性。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Vascular and Endovascular Surgery: From Prediction to Surgeon-Led Clinical Implementation.
zh_title: 血管与腔内手术中的AI：从预测到外科医生主导落地
summary: 叙述性综述评估血管外科AI从技术预测走向临床实施的证据，含影像、风险分层与教育。
key_points: 深度学习可分割主动脉解剖并支持EVAR后影像
机器学习可分层死亡与治疗风险
日本相关报告被单独提及，落地仍有限
reason: 叙述性综述，无原始数据或系统评价，属值得一看档
abstract: [Annals of vascular diseases] Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown promising performance in vascular imaging, risk prediction, procedural support, surveillance, and education, but its translation into routine surgical care remains limited. This narrative review addresses a focused question: what evidence supports the transition of vascular AI from technical prediction to surgeon-led clinical implementation? A targeted PubMed search through July 24, 2026 identified international and Japan-based studies across the perioperative pathway. Deep-learning systems can segment aortic anatomy, characterize aneurysm or dissection, and support post-EVAR imaging. Machine-learning models may stratify mortality and treatment risk, whereas computer vision, image fusion, wearable monitoring, and large language models extend potential use into procedures, follow-up, and education. Japanese reports demonstrate locally relevant innovation in aortic imaging, EVAR prognosis, postoperative monitoring, and specialty education; however, most evidence remains retrospective, single-center, or developmental. Selected surgeon-led workflows, including quantitative spinal cord imaging after aortic repair, are presented with explicit data provenance as illustrative demonstrations, not proof of clinical efficacy. Progress requires external validation, workflow and human-factors evaluation, prospective impact studies, transparent reporting, and post-deployment monitoring. AI should augment vascular specialists, with surgeons retaining responsibility for clinical questions, verification, interpretation, and patient care.
zh_abstract: [Annals of vascular diseases] 人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在血管成像、风险预测、手术过程支持、监测和教育中已显示出有前景的表现，但其向常规外科护理的转化仍然有限。本叙述性综述聚焦一个明确问题：有哪些证据支持血管 AI 从技术预测转向由外科医生主导的临床实施？截至 2026 年 7 月 24 日开展的目标性 PubMed 检索，识别了围手术期路径中的国际研究和日本研究。深度学习系统可分割主动脉解剖结构、表征动脉瘤或夹层，并支持 EVAR 术后成像。机器学习模型可对死亡率和治疗风险进行分层，而计算机视觉、图像融合、可穿戴监测和大语言模型将潜在用途扩展到手术过程、随访和教育。日本的研究报告展示了在主动脉成像、EVAR 预后、术后监测和专业教育方面具有本地相关性的创新；然而，大多数证据仍为回顾性、单中心或处于开发阶段。选取的外科医生主导工作流程（包括主动脉修复术后定量脊髓成像）以明确的数据来源作为示例性展示，而非临床有效性证明。进展需要外部验证、工作流程和人因评估、前瞻性影响研究、透明报告以及部署后监测。AI 应增强血管专科医生的能力，外科医生仍负责临床问题、验证、解释和患者照护。

title: Artificial intelligence prediction of implant placement difficulty based on bone morphology and anatomical constraints.
source: PubMed · Journal of oral biology and craniofacial research
zh_title: AI基于CBCT骨形态预测种植体植入难度
summary: 前瞻性观察250个种植位点，用CBCT骨形态与解剖约束参数构建AI模型预测植入难度。

abstract: [Journal of oral biology and craniofacial research] Accurate preoperative assessment of implant placement difficulty is essential for effective surgical planning and minimizing complications. Conventional evaluation using cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) relies heavily on clinician interpretation and is often subjective and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a promising approach for objective and reproducible prediction of surgical complexity using quantitative imaging parameters. To develop and evaluate an AI-based model for predicting implant placement difficulty based on bone morphology and anatomical constraints derived from CBCT imaging. A prospective observational study was conducted on 250 implant sites. Bone morphology parameters-including bone height, width, cortical thickness, and density-along with anatomical constraints such as proximity to vital structures, were assessed using standardized CBCT analysis. Implant placement difficulty was categorized intraoperatively as low, moderate, or high. Machine learning models, including logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost, were developed using Python libraries. Model performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, area under the curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, and calibration metrics such as the Brier score. Moderate difficulty cases were most common (41.6%), followed by low (36.8%) and high (21.6%) difficulty. Reduced bone dimensions and density were significantly associated with increased difficulty (p < 0.001). XGBoost showed the best performance (AUC 0.91, accuracy 87.6%, sensitivity 0.85, specificity 0.89, Brier score 0.108). AI models, particularly XGBoost, can reliably predict implant placement difficulty and enhance clinical decision-making and treatment planning.
zh_abstract: [Journal of oral biology and craniofacial research] 准确术前评估种植体植入难度对于有效的手术规划和尽量减少并发症至关重要。使用锥形束计算机断层扫描（cone-beam computed tomography, CBCT）的常规评估在很大程度上依赖临床医生的解释，并且通常是主观且依赖操作者的。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）为利用定量成像参数对手术复杂性进行客观且可重复的预测提供了一种有前景的方法。开发并评估一种基于 CBCT 成像得出的骨形态和解剖限制来预测种植体植入难度的 AI 模型。对 250 个种植位点进行了前瞻性观察性研究。使用标准化 CBCT 分析评估骨形态参数——包括骨高度、宽度、皮质厚度和密度——以及解剖限制，例如与重要结构的邻近程度。术中按低、中或高对种植体植入难度进行分类。使用 Python 库开发机器学习模型，包括逻辑回归、随机森林和 XGBoost。使用受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）分析、曲线下面积（area under the curve, AUC）、敏感性、特异性以及校准指标（如 Brier 评分）评估模型性能。中等难度病例最常见（41.6%），其次是低难度（36.8%）和高难度（21.6%）。骨尺寸和密度降低与难度增加显著相关（p < 0.001）。XGBoost 表现最佳（AUC 0.91，准确率 87.6%，敏感性 0.85，特异性 0.89，Brier 评分 0.108）。AI 模型，尤其是 XGBoost，能够可靠预测种植体植入难度，并增强临床决策和治疗规划。

title: AI for Poststroke Epilepsy: Scoping Review of Imaging-Based Prediction Models and Implications for African Settings.

abstract: [JMIR AI] Poststroke seizures (PSS) and poststroke epilepsy (PSE) are important neurological complications associated with poorer functional recovery, increased mortality, and reduced quality of life after stroke. Neuroimaging plays a central role in identifying patients at increased risk, and recent advances in AI have enabled the development of imaging-based prediction models that may improve individualized risk stratification. However, the current evidence remains fragmented, and the extent to which these approaches are applicable to African health care settings is unclear. This scoping review aimed to chart the existing global evidence on the development of imaging-based prediction models that can help in predicting PSS and PSE, especially AI-based ones. The purpose was to look into the imaging techniques, computational algorithms, and validation methodologies used and the representation of African populations. This scoping review was performed using the Joanna Briggs Institute methodological framework, and the results were presented based on the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) framework. Articles searched using databases such as PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar involved the application of computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), angiography imaging techniques, radiomic markers, or multimodal neuroimaging techniques in statistical and AI-based prediction models for seizure-related outcomes after stroke. Twenty-three studies published between 2005 and 2026 met the eligibility criteria. The evidence demonstrated a clear methodological evolution from conventional imaging-based prediction models to radiomics, machine learning, deep learning, explainable AI, and multimodal approaches. MRI and CT were the predominant imaging modalities, with cortical involvement, lesion location, infarct volume, hemorrhagic transformation, and quantitative radiomic features emerging as the most frequently reported imaging predictors. Most AI models relied on internal validation, while relatively few underwent external validation. title: Artificial intelligence, explainable deep learning, and generative models for osteoporosis and bone disease prediction: a systematic review and future research roadmap.

summary: 按PRISMA 2020完成的系统综述，整合机器学习、深度学习、可解释AI、生成模型与多模态学习在骨质疏松预测中的研究并给出路线图。

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Osteoporosis is a major global health burden, with considerable morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs. Artificial intelligence (AI) has opened new avenues for osteoporosis screening, bone mineral density quantification, fracture-risk prediction, and clinical decision support, but progress remains fragmented across machine learning, deep learning, explainable AI (XAI), generative models, and multimodal learning. This systematic review brings these strands together and identifies priority research needs for AI-based osteoporosis prediction. Following the PRISMA 2020 statement, studies were identified from Scopus and Google Scholar, published between January 2020 and the final search date of 30 June 2026, with two reviewers screening independently and resolving disagreements by consensus. Design-related risk-of-bias indicators, such as retrospective vs. prospective design, validation strategy, and reference standard, were recorded for every study; a full PROBAST, QUADAS-2, and Newcastle-Ottawa Scale appraisal is planned but not yet complete. Fifty-eight studies met the inclusion criteria and were synthesized narratively and descriptively, without formal meta-analysis, given substantial heterogeneity. Findings spanned five themes: classical machine learning, deep learning for imaging, explainable AI, generative models, and multimodal learning. Deep learning achieved strong predictive accuracy (AUC 0.82-0.96), XAI improved clinical interpretability, generative models helped offset data scarcity, and multimodal approaches boosted performance by combining imaging and clinical data. Key gaps remain, including limited external validation, heavy reliance on retrospective data, poor generalisability, and limited regulatory readiness. Building on these findings, this review proposes MXGNet, a multimodal, explainable, generative framework incorporating privacy-preserving federated learning, intended to guide development of robust, interpretable, clinically deployable AI tools for osteoporosis prediction.
zh_abstract: 骨质疏松症是全球主要健康负担，具有相当的发病率、死亡率和医疗保健成本。人工智能（AI）为骨质疏松症筛查、骨密度定量、骨折风险预测和临床决策支持开辟了新途径，但进展在机器学习、深度学习、可解释 AI（XAI）、生成模型和多模态学习之间仍然分散。本系统综述将这些线索汇集在一起，并确定了基于 AI 的骨质疏松症预测的优先研究需求。遵循 PRISMA 2020 声明，从 Scopus 和 Google Scholar 识别研究，发表时间在 2020 年 1 月至最终检索日期 2026 年 6 月 30 日之间，由两名评审员独立筛选并通过共识解决分歧。每项研究均记录了设计相关的偏倚风险指标，如回顾性与前瞻性设计、验证策略和参考标准；完整的 PROBAST、QUADAS-2 和纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表（Newcastle-Ottawa Scale）评估已计划但尚未完成。58 项研究符合纳入标准，并鉴于相当大的异质性，以叙述性和描述性方式综合，未进行正式荟萃分析。研究结果涵盖五个主题：经典机器学习、用于成像的深度学习、可解释 AI、生成模型和多模态学习。深度学习取得了很强的预测准确性（AUC 0.82-0.96），XAI 提高了临床可解释性，生成模型有助于抵消数据稀缺，多模态方法通过结合成像和临床数据提升了性能。关键差距仍然存在，包括外部验证有限、严重依赖回顾性数据、泛化性差和监管准备有限。基于这些发现，本综述提出 MXGNet，一个多模态、可解释、生成式框架，纳入隐私保护联邦学习，旨在指导开发稳健、可解释、临床可部署的 AI 工具用于骨质疏松症预测。

title: Beyond diagnostic accuracy: navigating the artificial intelligence data tsunami toward value-based implementation in gastroenterology.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy has evolved from its early application in simple edge detection to highly sophisticated technologies designed to improve detection of neoplastic and preneoplastic lesions and support clinical decision-making. However, this rapid technological evolution has generated a "data tsunami" or "datanami": an overwhelming and continuously expanding volume of information that, frequently, exceeds the ability of clinicians and patients to process, interpret, and apply it effectively. Substantial investments in AI have been driven by expectations of improved efficiency and reduced healthcare costs. Nevertheless, the metrics used to justify the adoption of AI-assisted diagnostic and therapeutic strategies remain inadequately standardized, leaving the true cost-effectiveness of these technologies uncertain. Current AI research in gastroenterology has primarily focused on improving diagnostic performance rather than evaluating long-term clinical outcomes or economic value. To address this limitation, investigators employ stochastic microsimulation models, which simulate individual patient trajectories and enable more robust assessments of cost-effectiveness. As the field progresses from AI to extended intelligence and, ultimately, intelligent assistance, the role of humans becomes increasingly central. Rather than replacing clinical judgment, AI should augment human expertise, with healthcare professionals serving as the critical link between technological innovation and meaningful clinical benefit. This review examines whether AI applications in GI diseases can be implemented cost-effectively in routine clinical practice for diagnosis and treatment. It further explores the indispensable human dimension of AI adoption, emphasizing accountability, reliability, ethical oversight, and responsible implementation as essential safeguards for current and future clinical applications.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 人工智能（AI）在胃肠道（GI）内镜中的应用已从早期简单的边缘检测发展到高度复杂的技术，旨在改善肿瘤性和癌前病变的检测并支持临床决策。然而，这种快速的技术演进产生了“数据海啸”或“datanami”：即压倒性且持续扩展的信息量，常常超出临床医生和患者有效处理、解释和应用它的能力。对 AI 的大量投资是由提高效率和降低医疗成本的期望驱动的。然而，用于证明采用 AI 辅助诊断和治疗策略合理性的指标仍缺乏充分标准化，使这些技术的真实成本效益仍不确定。当前胃肠病学中的 AI 研究主要侧重于提高诊断性能，而非评估长期临床结局或经济价值。为克服这一局限，研究者采用随机微观模拟模型，该模型模拟个体患者轨迹，并能够对成本效益进行更稳健的评估。随着该领域从 AI 发展到扩展智能（extended intelligence），并最终发展到智能辅助（intelligent assistance），人的作用变得越来越核心。AI 不应取代临床判断，而应增强人类专业知识，医疗专业人员应作为技术创新与有意义临床获益之间的关键纽带。本综述探讨 AI 在 GI 疾病中的应用能否以成本效益方式在常规临床实践中用于诊断和治疗。它还探讨 AI 采用中不可或缺的人性维度，强调问责、可靠性、伦理监督和负责任实施，作为当前和未来临床应用的重要保障。

abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder, where traditional diagnostic methods are constrained by limited sensitivity and restricted clinical utility. This review synthesizes recent applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in AD diagnostics, focusing on machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) across neuroimaging modalities and multi-omics research. AI algorithms can automatically extract subtle microstructural, metabolic, and molecular features, enabling high-precision classification of AD stages, patient stratification, and non-invasive early screening through multimodal data integration. However, translating AI into routine clinical practice still faces critical challenges, including high equipment costs, insufficient model generalizability across real-world cohorts, data class imbalance, and complex cross-platform standardization barriers. Future research should prioritize cost-effective surrogate modeling, robust multi-center validation, dynamic longitudinal integration, and mechanistic interpretability to accelerate the standardized clinical translation of AI-driven AD diagnostics.
zh_abstract: ［Frontiers in neurology］阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease，AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，传统诊断方法受限于敏感性有限和临床实用性受限。本综述综合了人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）在 AD 诊断中的近期应用，重点关注机器学习（machine learning，ML）和深度学习（deep learning，DL）在神经影像模态和多组学研究中的应用。AI 算法能够自动提取细微的微结构、代谢和分子特征，从而通过多模态数据整合实现 AD 分期的高精度分类、患者分层和无创早期筛查。然而，将 AI 转化为常规临床实践仍面临关键挑战，包括设备成本高、模型在真实世界队列中的泛化能力不足、数据类别不平衡以及复杂的跨平台标准化障碍。未来研究应优先关注具有成本效益的替代建模、稳健的多中心验证、动态纵向整合和机制可解释性，以加速 AI 驱动的 AD 诊断的标准化临床转化。

title: Deep learning and metaheuristic optimization for predicting drug release from nanocarrier systems: a data-driven framework for formulation development.

abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Drug-release profiles from nanocarrier systems are governed by nonlinear and multiphasic physicochemical interactions that are difficult to predict using conventional kinetic models. This study presents a data-driven predictive framework that integrates deep neural networks (DNNs) with three bio-inspired metaheuristic optimization algorithms: the Transit Search Optimization Algorithm (TSA), Crocodile Hunting Strategy (CHS), and Osprey Optimization Algorithm (OOA). The models were developed and evaluated using a dataset of 403 nanocarrier formulations compiled from 237 peer-reviewed studies. Predictive performance was assessed using RMSE, MSE, R2, Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE), and GR125, followed by multi-criteria ranking with TOPSIS and statistical validation using the Kruskal-Wallis and Friedman tests. Among the evaluated models, the OOA-optimized DNN achieved the best overall performance, reaching a minimum RMSE of approximately 1.01 and an R2 of approximately 0.99 while exhibiting stable convergence and statistically significant improvements over the competing optimization strategies. The proposed framework provides a robust in-silico tool for modeling complex drug-release behavior, reducing experimental screening requirements, and supporting data-driven formulation optimization, Quality by Design (QbD), and Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) for nanocarrier systems.

title: Determining cellular phylogeny and migration at high resolution in spatial genomics

abstract: Cellular migration and tumor evolution are central to tissue homeostasis and cancer biology. Rapid advances in spatial genomics have raised the possibility of using somatic mutations to track these processes in situ in human tissues. However, frequent data dropouts in spatial genomics measurements make this challenging to implement. Here, we present StarTrak (SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing), a framework for somatic variant calling and lineage reconstruction at single-pixel spatial resolution. StarTrak employs a neural network framework to integrate mutational evidence (from both nuclear and mitochondrial reads), spatial proximity, histological images, and transcriptomic states to identify spatially informative patterns of mutations. It performs robustly across tissue types and spatial-omics platforms (being particularly successful with spatial ATAC-seq). Applying StarTrak to tumor sections, we infer the migration of mutated tumor cells into adjacent non-malignant tissues and reconstruct distinct lineage trees associated with different spatial regions. Notably, we identify tumor regions with nearly identical transcriptomic states but distinct mutational profiles. Moreover, for skin sections, StarTrak identifies sunlight-associated mutations in non-malignant epidermis and evidence suggesting the migration of these mutant surface cells into deeper skin layers. Overall, by integrating mutation calling with spatial context, StarTrak enables the inference of spatially resolved cellular migration and cellular phylogeny.
zh_abstract: 细胞迁移和肿瘤进化是组织稳态与癌症生物学的核心。空间基因组学的快速进展提出了利用体细胞突变在人体组织中原位追踪这些过程的可能性。然而，空间基因组学测量中频繁的数据丢失使这一设想难以实施。在此，我们提出 StarTrak（SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing，利用体细胞变异检测与追踪进行谱系重建的空间分析），这是一个在单像素空间分辨率下进行体细胞变异检测和谱系重建的框架。StarTrak 采用神经网络框架，整合突变证据（来自细胞核和线粒体测序读段）、空间邻近性、组织学图像和转录组状态，以识别具有空间信息意义的突变模式。它在不同组织类型和空间组学平台中表现稳健（在空间 ATAC-seq 中尤为成功）。将 StarTrak 应用于肿瘤切片，我们推断突变肿瘤细胞向邻近非恶性组织的迁移，并重建与不同空间区域相关的不同谱系树。值得注意的是，我们识别出转录组状态几乎相同但突变谱不同的肿瘤区域。此外，对于皮肤切片，StarTrak 识别出非恶性表皮中的日光相关突变，以及提示这些突变表层细胞向更深皮肤层迁移的证据。总体而言，通过将突变检测与空间背景整合，StarTrak 能够推断空间分辨的细胞迁移和细胞系统发育。

title: CAPO: Compute-Aware Automated Protein-Model Optimization
zh_title: CAPO：算力感知的蛋白质模型自动优化
summary: 预印本提出多智能体系统，在算力预算约束下先判断是否及如何适配蛋白质模型。
key_points: 把蛋白模型适配建模为带门控的决策问题
强调先测量可行性与成本再消耗算力
面向ESM、AlphaFold、Boltz等预训练模型
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但证据与验证范围有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein models such as Evolutionary Scale Modeling (ESM), AlphaFold and Boltz have transformed computational protein science, yet a pretrained model rarely transfers to a particular laboratory's assay without adaptation to its data and experimental setting, and that adaptation is technically demanding and spends real compute budget. Existing agentic systems can automate model training, yet typically treat fine-tuning as a reliable tool call: feasibility and cost are estimated rather than measured, and infeasibility is discovered only after compute has been spent. We formulate protein-model adaptation as a gated decision problem: given a task, raw data and a compute budget c_max, a system should decide whether and how to adapt a model before committing expensive computation. We introduce CAPO (Compute-Aware Automated Protein-Model Optimization), a multi-agent system built around one rule: gate before you train. CAPO measures feasibility on the target accelerator, projects cost against the available budget, runs a canary inside the actual training loop and maintains an auditable artifact trail; critically, it can decline an unaffordable adaptation and select a cheaper alternative. We evaluate CAPO, without system changes, on three protein-modeling tasks: (i) SARS-CoV-2 host-range prediction, (ii) hit-to-lead affinity ranking and (iii) temporal variant-effect reclassification. On host range, CAPO partially fine-tuned an 8-million-parameter ESM-2 model to a species-averaged MCC of 0.826, compared with 0.743 for a hand-designed expert transformer; it matched a general coding agent while using 57.4% less GPU time and reduced failed training trials from four to zero. For hit-to-lead affinity ranking, CAPO rejected Boltz-2 fine-tuning and instead trained an assay-calibrated lightweight head over frozen representations, improving ranking on 11 of 15 held-out targets in 1.68 GPU-hours. On temporally held-out ClinVar variants, rank-4 low-rank adaptation of ESM-2 reached an MCC of 0.478, compared with 0.252 for a one-hot baseline and 0.000 for the frozen zero-shot score. These results come from single runs, without a gate ablation and with one generalist-agent comparison. Within those limits, they show that measured admission control can make protein-model adaptation not only automated but selective: deciding what to compute, what not to compute and why.
zh_abstract: 诸如进化尺度建模（Evolutionary Scale Modeling, ESM）、AlphaFold和Boltz等蛋白质模型已经改变了计算蛋白质科学，然而预训练模型很少能在不根据特定实验室的数据和实验设置进行适应的情况下迁移到该实验室的测定中，而这种适应在技术上要求高，并会消耗真实的计算预算。现有智能体系统可以自动化模型训练，但通常将微调视为可靠的工具调用：可行性和成本是被估计而不是被测量，不可行性只有在计算已经花费后才被发现。我们将蛋白质模型适应形式化为一个门控决策问题：给定一个任务、原始数据和一个计算预算c_max，系统应在投入昂贵计算之前决定是否以及如何适应模型。我们提出CAPO（Compute-Aware Automated Protein-Model Optimization，计算感知的自动化蛋白质模型优化），这是一个围绕一条规则构建的多智能体系统：训练前先门控。CAPO在目标加速器上测量可行性，根据可用预算预测成本，在实际训练循环内运行金丝雀检查，并维护可审计的制品轨迹；关键的是，它可以拒绝负担不起的适应，并选择更便宜的替代方案。我们在不改变系统的情况下，在三个蛋白质建模任务上评估CAPO：（i）SARS-CoV-2宿主范围预测，（ii）从命中到先导化合物的亲和力排序，以及（iii）时间变异效应重新分类。在宿主范围方面，CAPO对一个800万参数的ESM-2模型进行部分微调，达到物种平均MCC 0.826，而手工设计的专家transformer为0.743；它在使用少57.4% GPU时间的情况下匹配了一个通用编码智能体，并将失败的训练试验从四次减少到零次。对于从命中到先导化合物的亲和力排序，CAPO拒绝了Boltz-2微调，转而在冻结表示上训练一个经测定校准的轻量级头部，在1.68 GPU小时内改善了15个留出靶标中11个的排序。在时间留出的ClinVar变异上，ESM-2的秩4低秩适应达到MCC 0.478，而one-hot基线为0.252，冻结零样本分数为0.000。这些结果来自单次运行，没有进行门控消融，并且只与一个通用智能体进行了比较。在这些限制内，它们表明，经过测量的准入控制可以使蛋白质模型适应不仅自动化而且具有选择性：决定计算什么、不计算什么以及为什么。

title: Scalable Enzyme Reaction Retrieval Enables Metagenomic Biocatalyst Discovery
zh_title: 可扩展酶反应检索用于宏基因组生物催化剂发现
summary: 预印本发布轻量框架EzHit，用于双向酶-反应检索，在酶注释与孤儿反应检索基准上优于代表性基线。
key_points: 框架名为EzHit，支持双向酶-反应检索
在酶注释与孤儿反应检索基准上排名靠前
马氏距离几何置信优于概率型不确定性
reason: 新方法预印本，有基线对比但尚缺外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Enzyme catalyzed reactions drive metabolism and enable diverse applications in biotechnology and sustainable synthesis, but assigning catalytic functions to uncharacterized enzymes and finding enzymes for target reactions remain major challenges. Despite recent advances in machine learning, translating enzyme function prediction into systematic discovery across the vast space of uncharacterized proteins and biochemical reactions remains challenging. Here we present EzHit, a lightweight framework for bidirectional enzyme reaction retrieval. Across enzyme annotation, orphan-reaction retrieval and family-specific fine-tuning benchmarks, EzHit achieved strong top-ranked performance and outperformed representative enzyme reaction matching baselines. We further show that Mahalanobis distance based geometric confidence provides more useful reliability estimates than probability-derived uncertainty metrics or evidential learning, enabling confidence-aware prioritization of high scoring candidates. Owing to its efficiency, EzHit was applied to a nearly trillion-scale OMG_Prot50 with RHEA screen, yielding 8.20 billion retained enzyme reaction associations across 30.27 million predicted enzyme sequences. Experimental validation further confirmed the activity of EzHit prioritized metagenomic enzyme candidates for a sparsely annotated reaction. Together, these results establish EzHit as a scalable framework for enzyme annotation, reaction-guided mining and biocatalyst discovery
zh_abstract: 酶催化反应驱动代谢，并在生物技术和可持续合成中实现多种应用，但为未表征的酶分配催化功能以及为目标反应寻找酶仍然是重大挑战。尽管机器学习近期取得了进展，但将酶功能预测转化为在庞大的未表征蛋白质和生化反应空间中的系统性发现仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 EzHit，一个用于双向酶-反应检索的轻量级框架。在酶注释、孤儿反应（orphan-reaction）检索和家族特异性微调基准中，EzHit 取得了强劲的排名第一的性能，并优于代表性的酶-反应匹配基线。我们进一步表明，基于马氏距离（Mahalanobis distance）的几何置信度比概率衍生的不确定性度量或证据学习（evidential learning）提供了更有用的可靠性估计，从而能够对高分候选进行置信度感知的优先级排序。由于其高效性，EzHit 被应用于近万亿规模的 OMG_Prot50 与 RHEA 筛选，在 30.27 million 条预测酶序列中产生了 8.20 billion 个保留的酶-反应关联。实验验证进一步证实了 EzHit 优先排序的宏基因组酶候选物对一个注释稀疏反应的活性。总之，这些结果确立了 EzHit 作为酶注释、反应引导挖掘和生物催化剂发现的可扩展框架。

title: AI in Proton Therapy Treatment Planning: A Narrative Review.
source: PubMed · International journal of particle therapy
zh_title: AI在质子治疗计划制定中的应用：叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述按工作流环节梳理AI在质子治疗计划中的应用及验证策略。
key_points: 覆盖影像、配准、分割、剂量预测与优化
强调剂量精度、鲁棒性与自适应决策要求
按应用领域与验证策略归纳研究
reason: 叙述性综述按上限最高6分，信息有组织但无新证据
abstract: [International journal of particle therapy] Proton therapy provides superior dose conformity compared to photon therapy, but its treatment planning is challenged by sensitivity to anatomical changes, setup/range uncertainties, and computational complexity. This narrative review evaluates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in improving proton therapy treatment planning, with emphasis on proton-specific requirements for dose-calculation accuracy, robustness, and adaptive decision-making. Recent studies on AI applications across the proton therapy planning workflow, including imaging, registration, segmentation, contour assessment, dose prediction/denoising, optimization, adaptive therapy, and large language model (LLM) and multimodal AI were reviewed and summarized by application domain and validation strategy. Both proton-therapy-specific studies and selected general radiotherapy AI studies were included when they introduced methods relevant to proton treatment planning, with attention to the additional validation needed for proton therapy. AI has shown promise in enhancing imaging for dose calculation, automating contouring and contour assessment, accelerating dose calculation, predicting and denoising dose distributions, supporting robust optimization, and improving adaptive planning workflows. Compared with photon therapy, AI tools in proton therapy require more stringent evaluation because errors in AI-generated images, deformation fields, contours, dose estimates, or optimization outputs may propagate into water-equivalent path length, range uncertainty, scenario-specific dose distributions, and adaptive replanning decisions. Emerging applications, including LLMs and multimodal foundation models, may further support clinical-context integration, treatment-planning documentation, plan review, and workflow coordination. Key limitations include data scarcity, limited generalizability, physical interpretability, uncertainty management, lack of standardized proton-specific benchmarks, and limited prospective validation. AI is emerging as a key enabler of efficient, consistent, and patient-specific proton therapy treatment planning. Clinical translation will require interpretable and physics-aware models, multi-institutional validation, workflow-level testing, and evaluation using proton-specific endpoints such as HU/RSP accuracy, range error, dose-calculation accuracy, robustness, deliverability, and adaptive decision consistency.
zh_abstract: [International journal of particle therapy] 与光子治疗相比，质子治疗提供更优的剂量适形性，但其治疗计划受到对解剖变化、摆位/射程不确定性和计算复杂性的敏感性的挑战。本叙述性综述评估人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在改善质子治疗计划中的作用，重点强调质子治疗对剂量计算准确性、稳健性和自适应决策的特定要求。本文按应用领域和验证策略对近期关于 AI 在质子治疗计划工作流程中应用的研究进行了综述和总结，涵盖成像、配准、分割、轮廓评估、剂量预测/去噪、优化、自适应治疗以及大语言模型（large language model, LLM）和多模态 AI。纳入质子治疗特异性研究以及部分通用放射治疗 AI 研究（当其介绍与质子治疗计划相关的方法时），并关注质子治疗所需的额外验证。AI 在增强用于剂量计算的成像、自动勾画和轮廓评估、加速剂量计算、预测和去噪剂量分布、支持稳健优化以及改善自适应计划工作流程方面已显示出前景。与光子治疗相比，质子治疗中的 AI 工具需要更严格的评估，因为 AI 生成的图像、变形场、轮廓、剂量估计或优化输出中的误差可能传播至水等效路径长度、射程不确定性、情景特异性剂量分布和自适应再计划决策。包括 LLM 和多模态基础模型在内的新兴应用，可能进一步支持临床背景整合、治疗计划文档、计划审核和工作流程协调。关键局限性包括数据稀缺、泛化性有限、物理可解释性、不确定性管理、缺乏标准化的质子治疗特异性基准以及前瞻性验证有限。AI 正逐渐成为高效、一致且患者特异性质子治疗计划的关键使能因素。临床转化将需要可解释且具备物理感知的模型、多机构验证、工作流程层面测试，以及使用质子治疗特异性终点（如 HU/RSP 准确性、射程误差、剂量计算准确性、稳健性、可递送性和自适应决策一致性）进行评估。

title: AI safety is a system property, not a sum of individual defenses.
zh_title: AI安全是系统属性而非防御叠加
summary: 论证LLM安全失效维度相互放大，并在MedQA临床病例上审计GPT-5与Claude-Sonnet-4.6。
key_points: 提出四类安全挑战并分析其交互与复合失效
单次越狱可同时影响多个安全维度
模型与攻击方式不同，受影响模式存在差异
reason: 观点类文章上限6分，含小规模模型审计但无临床结局
abstract: [Patterns (New York, N.Y.)] Safety for large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents remains fragmented; defenses against jailbreaking coexist with unresolved hallucination, fairness, and autonomous-control problems. Existing frameworks address these risks, but few specify how failure in one dimension changes another within a deployment. We argue that distinct safety failures can interact and amplify each other. We identify four safety challenge classes, analyze their interactions, and ground the argument in real-world incidents involving compound failures. We then audit GPT-5 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6 on clinical vignettes from the Medical Question Answering benchmark based on the United States Medical Licensing Examination (MedQA-USMLE). A single jailbreak can affect multiple safety dimensions, although patterns vary by model and attack. We propose three design principles for integrated safety architectures and identify agent safety and mechanistic interpretability as urgent open frontiers.
zh_abstract: [Patterns (New York, N.Y.)] 大型语言模型（LLMs）和人工智能（AI）智能体的安全性仍然碎片化；针对越狱的防御与尚未解决的幻觉、公平性和自主控制问题并存。现有框架处理这些风险，但很少有框架说明在一个部署中，一个维度的失败如何改变另一个维度。我们认为，不同的安全失败可以相互作用并相互放大。我们识别出四类安全挑战，分析其相互作用，并将论点建立在涉及复合失败的真实世界事件之上。随后，我们在来自基于美国医师执照考试（United States Medical Licensing Examination）的医学问答基准（MedQA-USMLE）的临床病例摘要上审计 GPT-5 和 Claude-Sonnet-4.6。一次越狱可以影响多个安全维度，尽管模式因模型和攻击而异。我们提出集成安全架构的三项设计原则，并指出智能体安全与机制可解释性是紧迫的开放前沿。

title: Toward End-to-end Artificial Intelligence Systems for Radiographic Fracture Assessment: A Critical Review of Detection, Explainability, and Prognosis.
zh_title: 影像骨折评估的端到端AI系统：批判性综述
summary: 以七阶段全流程框架综述骨折影像AI的检测、可解释性与预后建模进展与缺口。
key_points: 提出涵盖预处理到临床部署的七阶段端到端流程
现有系统擅长基础检测，预后建模与落地不足
量化骨折表征与内在可解释学习进展相对滞后
reason: 综述类最高6分；提出统一流程框架具参考价值，但无新实验数据。
abstract: [Journal of medical physics] This review synthesizes recent advances in fracture intelligence through a unified seven-stage end-to-end pipeline that includes preprocessing and (region of interest) ROI extraction, fracture detection, classification, localization and segmentation, prognostic modeling, explainability, and clinical deployment. By shifting the focus from isolated algorithms to complete clinical workflows, we expose a critical gap: current systems excel at basic detection but struggle with complex prognostic modeling and real-world deployment. Within this framework, we critically analyze methodological progress, highlight enduring research challenges, and demonstrate that fracture artificial intelligence continues to be detection focused with relatively less advancement in quantitative fracture characterization, prognostic intelligence, intrinsically interpretable learning, and prospective clinical validation. Based on these findings, we outline future research directions toward unified, anatomically informed, clinically deployable fracture intelligence systems.
zh_abstract: 《Journal of Medical Physics》本综述通过一个统一的七阶段端到端流程，综合了骨折智能领域的最新进展，该流程包括预处理与感兴趣区（region of interest, ROI）提取、骨折检测、分类、定位与分割、预后建模、可解释性以及临床部署。通过将焦点从孤立算法转向完整临床工作流程，我们揭示了一个关键空白：当前系统擅长基础检测，但在复杂预后建模和真实世界部署方面仍存在困难。在该框架内，我们批判性分析方法学进展，强调持续存在的研究挑战，并表明骨折人工智能仍以检测为重点，在定量骨折表征、预后智能、内在可解释学习和前瞻性临床验证方面进展相对较少。基于这些发现，我们概述了未来研究方向，即朝着统一、基于解剖学信息、临床可部署的骨折智能系统发展。

title: LigRNA: High-accuracy prediction of RNA-ligand binding sites via dynamic chemical complementarity and language model encoding
zh_title: LigRNA：基于动态化学互补与语言模型的 RNA-配体结合位点预测
summary: 预印本提出图神经网络框架，联合编码 RNA 与配体，预测 RNA-小分子结合位点。
key_points: 跨模态联合编码 RNA 残基与配体官能团
融合结构语言模型嵌入与可及表面积等理化特征
配体以图注意力网络编码保留原子级信息
reason: 有新方法的药物发现预印本，但证据限于方法描述，属值得一看档
abstract: RNA-binding small molecules represent a validated therapeutic modality, yet pinpointing their exact RNA binding sites remains critical for mechanistic understanding and drug optimization. Experimental methods, while precise, are costly and low-throughput, necessitating robust computational alternatives. Approaches based on static feature concatenation may overlook input-dependent relationships between RNA residues and ligand functional groups. Here we present LigRNA, a graph neural network framework that predicts RNA-ligand binding sites through joint cross-modal encoding of both molecules. LigRNA integrates structure-guided language model embeddings with physicochemical features-solvent-accessible surface area and secondary structure types, to construct comprehensive RNA representations. Ligands are encoded as attributed molecular graphs via graph attention networks, preserving atom-level chemical topology rather than compressing molecules into fixed fingerprints. A cross-attention mechanism then enables dynamic, ligand-dependent modulation of RNA nucleotide attention, capturing context-specific interaction patterns. Benchmarked on TE9 and TE18 datasets, LigRNA achieves F1 scores of 0.73 and 0.58, improving on GATRsite by 7.4% and 18.4%, respectively. Ablation studies identify the RNA residual encoder as the most consistent contributor across the two benchmarks. The source code is freely available at https://github.com/WillowWang0216/LigRNA.
zh_abstract: RNA结合小分子是一种经过验证的治疗方式，但确定其确切的RNA结合位点仍对机制理解和药物优化至关重要。实验方法虽然精确，但成本高且通量低，因此需要稳健的计算替代方法。基于静态特征拼接的方法可能忽略RNA残基与配体官能团之间依赖于输入的关系。在此我们提出LigRNA，一个图神经网络框架，通过对两种分子的联合跨模态编码来预测RNA-配体结合位点。LigRNA将结构引导的语言模型嵌入与物理化学特征——溶剂可及表面积和二级结构类型——整合，以构建全面的RNA表示。配体通过图注意力网络编码为带属性的分子图，保留原子级化学拓扑结构，而不是将分子压缩为固定指纹。交叉注意力机制随后能够对RNA核苷酸注意力进行动态的、配体依赖的调制，捕获上下文特异性相互作用模式。在TE9和TE18数据集上进行基准测试，LigRNA的F1分数分别为0.73和0.58，较GATRsite分别提高7.4%和18.4%。消融研究确定RNA残基编码器是两项基准中最一致的贡献者。源代码可在https://github.com/WillowWang0216/LigRNA免费获取。

title: PATHNet: A Thermodynamic Path-Integral-Inspired Neural Network for Protein-Ligand Interaction Prediction
zh_title: PATHNet：蛋白-配体相互作用预测网络
summary: 预印本提出物理启发的PATHNet打分框架，在7个DUD-E靶点上分类准确率优于三个基线。
key_points: 基于分子力学描述符学习非线性映射
采用变分最小作用量与谱约束正则
在7个DUD-E靶点上平均准确率最高
reason: 预印本新方法且有基线对比，但无外部验证，证据有限
abstract: Protein-ligand scoring functions must capture strongly nonlinear, target-dependent binding physics while remaining generalizable beyond their training data, a balance that purely analytic and purely data-driven models each struggle to achieve on their own. We present PATHNet, a physics-informed framework that learns this unknown functional relationship from molecular-mechanics descriptors using a non-monotonic piecewise-linear mapper with a bounded neural-network correction, trained through a variational, least-action-inspired objective and regulated by a renormalization-group-inspired spectral constraint, with model selection performed through multi-start basin optimization. Across seven DUD-E targets, PATHNet achieved the highest mean active inactive/decoy classification accuracy among the methods tested, outperforming three literature baselines representing distinct architectural families. These results support a physics-grounded, variationally constrained approach to neural-network scoring as a practical route toward more interpretable and transferable protein-ligand interaction models.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质-配体打分函数必须捕捉强非线性、靶点依赖的结合物理，同时保持超出其训练数据的泛化能力，而纯解析模型和纯数据驱动模型各自都难以单独实现这种平衡。我们提出 PATHNet，这是一个物理信息指导的框架，它使用带有有界神经网络校正的非单调分段线性映射器，从分子力学描述符中学习这种未知的函数关系；该框架通过变分、受最小作用量启发的目标函数进行训练，并受受重整化群启发的谱约束调控，模型选择通过多起点盆地优化完成。在七个 DUD-E 靶点上，PATHNet 在所测试方法中取得最高的平均活性物对非活性物/诱饵分类准确率，优于代表不同架构家族的三项文献基线。这些结果支持将基于物理、受变分约束的神经网络打分方法作为通往更可解释、更可迁移的蛋白质-配体相互作用模型的实用途径。

title: LGGS: Longitudinal MRI Reconstruction via Guided Group Sparsity
zh_title: LGGS：纵向引导组稀疏MRI重建
summary: 预印本提出可解释的纵向引导组稀疏框架，利用患者既往扫描加速MRI重建。
key_points: 利用同一患者既往扫描的先验信息
以学习到的相位不变循环注意力构建正则项
需应对随访间配准误差与病理变化
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，未见外部验证或临床结局
abstract: Serial MRI is routinely performed in current clinical practice for disease surveillance and applications such as MR-guided radiotherapy. However, long MRI scan times increase costs and limit patient access, making accelerated image reconstruction of broad clinical importance. Previous scans of the same patient contain image information highly correlated with the current exam, yet existing reconstruction methods rarely exploit this information. Major challenges in the effective use of prior scans include inter-visit misregistration, pathological changes, and image phase variation. In this work, we propose Longitudinal Guided Group Sparsity (LGGS), an interpretable deep-learning framework for longitudinally informed MRI reconstruction derived from classical group sparsity. The prior scan is incorporated into the reconstruction regularizer through learned phase-invariant circulant attention that identifies corresponding features across exams. This formulation provides robustness to local in-plane and through-plane misregistration as well as inter-visit phase variation. Across acceleration rates, LGGS achieves state-of-the-art performance on longitudinal T1-weighted multi-coil brain MRI data, outperforming the evaluated unguided and longitudinally informed reconstruction methods, with substantially fewer learned parameters. We further evaluated the contributions of multiple guide slices and phase-invariant similarity and demonstrated that accelerated prior images can also serve as effective guides with minimal degradation in reconstruction quality.
zh_abstract: 系列 MRI 在当前临床实践中常规用于疾病监测以及 MR 引导放疗等应用。然而，MRI 扫描时间长会增加成本并限制患者可及性，使加速图像重建具有广泛的临床重要性。同一患者既往扫描包含与当前检查高度相关的图像信息，但现有重建方法很少利用这一信息。有效利用既往扫描的主要挑战包括访视间配准不良、病理改变和图像相位变化。在本工作中，我们提出纵向引导组稀疏（Longitudinal Guided Group Sparsity，LGGS），这是一个源自经典组稀疏的可解释深度学习框架，用于纵向信息引导的 MRI 重建。既往扫描通过学习到的相位不变循环注意力被纳入重建正则项，该注意力可识别不同检查之间的对应特征。该公式对局部平面内和平面间配准不良以及访视间相位变化具有稳健性。在不同加速倍数下，LGGS 在纵向 T1 加权多线圈脑 MRI 数据上达到最先进性能，优于所评估的无引导和纵向信息引导重建方法，同时学习参数显著更少。我们进一步评估了多个引导切片和相位不变相似性的贡献，并证明加速的既往图像也可作为有效引导，且重建质量下降极小。

title: Alert-List Concordance for Evaluating Imputation Strategies in ICU Sepsis Prediction
zh_title: ICU脓毒症预测中插补策略的警报名单一致性评估
summary: 预印本提出用前k%警报集合的Jaccard相似度评估插补策略，发现聚合性能相近的流程会给出不同的高危患者名单。
key_points: 提出警报名单一致性指标并给自助法置信区间
基于PhysioNet/CinC 2019，40336例，缺失率71.9%
比较九种插补策略与原生缺失基线
reason: 方法有新意、样本大，但为预印本且缺少外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Preprocessing is an under-measured reliability risk in clinical prediction: a model can keep a similar AUROC and still change who receives an alert. Imputation quality is commonly evaluated using reconstruction error or aggregate discrimination, neither of which directly measures agreement on which patients are flagged. At a matched alert rate, pipelines with similar aggregate performance can produce different patient lists. This question is especially relevant under the frequent, structured missingness of real ICU records. We therefore introduce alert-list concordance, which asks whether two pipelines identify the same high-risk patients, measured by the Jaccard similarity of their top-k% alert sets with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. On PhysioNet/CinC 2019 (40,336 patients, 71.9% missingness), we compare nine imputation strategies and a native-missingness baseline using a fixed XGBoost configuration, fitted and Platt-calibrated separately for each strategy. After Bonferroni correction, 22 of the 28 reconstruction-method pairs showed no statistically significant difference in patient-level AUROC, yet their alert lists overlap at Jaccard 0.518 to 0.750. Similar aggregate discrimination can therefore accompany different patient selections. ForwardFill is a separate outlier, pairing higher discrimination with the lowest overlap in the matrix, 0.40 to 0.45. The broad pattern holds within each hospital system and under six patient-level aggregation rules. At the row level, eight of ten methods fall within an AUROC range of 0.011. In this row-level pipeline, deep imputers did not outperform mean imputation on discrimination, and the sequential implementations cost 5 to 12 times mean imputation in total pipeline wall-clock time on our hardware.
zh_abstract: 预处理是临床预测中一个未被充分衡量的可靠性风险：模型可以保持相似的 AUROC，却仍然改变哪些患者收到警报。插补质量通常使用重建误差或总体判别能力来评估，而这两者都不能直接衡量在哪些患者被标记上的一致性。在匹配的警报率下，总体性能相似的流程可能产生不同的患者名单。在真实 ICU 记录中频繁出现的结构化缺失情况下，这个问题尤其相关。因此，我们引入警报列表一致性，它询问两个流程是否识别出相同的高风险患者，并通过其前 k% 警报集合的 Jaccard 相似度及患者层面 bootstrap 置信区间来衡量。在 PhysioNet/CinC 2019（40,336 名患者，71.9% 缺失率）上，我们使用固定的 XGBoost 配置比较九种插补策略和一种原生缺失基线，并针对每种策略分别进行拟合和 Platt 校准。经 Bonferroni 校正后，28 个重建方法对中有 22 个在患者层面 AUROC 上无统计学显著差异，但其警报列表在 Jaccard 0.518 至 0.750 范围内重叠。因此，相似的总体判别能力可能伴随不同的患者选择。ForwardFill 是一个单独的离群点，其判别能力较高，同时在该矩阵中重叠度最低，为 0.40 至 0.45。这一总体模式在每个医院系统内以及六种患者层面聚合规则下均成立。在行层面，十种方法中有八种落在 0.011 的 AUROC 范围内。在这个行层面流程中，深度插补器在判别能力上并未优于均值插补，并且序贯实现在我们的硬件上花费的总流程墙钟时间是均值插补的 5 至 12 倍。

title: The Loss or the Architecture? What Matters in Survival Analysis with Competing Risks
zh_title: 竞争风险生存分析：损失函数还是架构？
summary: 预印本解耦损失函数与网络架构，在20个表格与3个病理图像数据集上比较竞争风险生存分析。
key_points: 在四种骨干网络上独立比较三种损失函数
覆盖20个表格数据集与3个病理图像数据集
在删失加权下直接建模累积发生率效果最佳
reason: 方法学设计规范且多数据集对比，但为预印本、无外部临床验证
abstract: Often, \emph{eg} in healthcare and predictive maintenance, what matters is which of several competing causes will strike first, and with what probability: survival analysis with competing risks. Corresponding deep learning methods are developed as bundles: a new architecture together with a new training loss, tested on one to five datasets against a handful of baselines. Thus, a state-of-the-art result cannot be attributed to the architecture, the loss, or the evaluation protocol. The coupling is not accidental: with one incidence curve per cause, a network's head is tied to the losses expressible on it. We vary the two axes independently, three losses, two of them strictly proper, on four backbones, across two modalities that tease the axes apart: 20 tabular and 3 pathology-image datasets. One loss wins in both: modelling cumulative incidence directly under censoring weighting. It brings twice as much as benefits a good choice of backbone on competing-risks data, and no more than it on single-event data: the loss is decisive for competing risks. The backbone matters too, and must match the modality: tabular networks lead on tables, pretrained vision encoders on images. The two choices compound rather than substitute. Proper scoring rules reveal these dynamics; the concordance index (C-index), which is not proper, does not separate models: neither axis moves it, not even tuning on the loss built to improve it. This is an avenue of progress: composed, the two give a model nobody has tried, RealMLP or TabM trained with the cumulative-incidence loss, which takes the best Brier score in our benchmark.
zh_abstract: 通常，例如在医疗保健和预测性维护中，重要的是若干竞争性原因中哪一个会先发生，以及以什么概率发生：竞争风险生存分析。相应的深度学习方法以捆绑形式开发：新架构连同新训练损失，在一到五个数据集上针对少数基线进行测试。因此，最先进的结果不能归因于架构、损失或评估协议。这种耦合并非偶然：每个原因一条发病曲线，网络的头部与其上可表达的损失绑定。我们独立变化两个轴，三种损失（其中两种是严格适当的）在四种骨干网络上，跨两种模态将轴分开：20 个表格数据集和 3 个病理图像数据集。一种损失在两者中都胜出：在删失加权下直接建模累积发病率。它在竞争风险数据上带来的益处是良好骨干选择的两倍，而在单事件数据上不超过后者：损失对竞争风险具有决定性。骨干网络也很重要，并且必须与模态匹配：表格网络在表格上领先，预训练视觉编码器在图像上领先。这两种选择相互叠加而非替代。严格适当评分规则揭示了这些动态；一致性指数（C-index）不是适当的，不能区分模型：两个轴都不能移动它，甚至针对为改善它而构建的损失进行调优也不能。这是一条进步途径：两者组合，得到一个没有人尝试过的模型，即用累积发病率损失训练的 RealMLP 或 TabM，在我们的基准中取得了最佳 Brier 分数。

title: Data-Efficient Classifier Pretraining Through Diffusion Models
zh_title: 基于扩散模型的数据高效分类器预训练
summary: 预印本提出DiffPT，用扩散建模预训练分类器主干，在医学影像与时间序列上优于对比类方法。
key_points: DiffPT为有限数据场景设计的扩散式预训练方法
对比预训练在CIFAR-10等自然图像低数据下更优
医学影像与时间序列任务上DiffPT表现更好
reason: 预印本新方法，含多类基线对比但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Machine learning with limited data is susceptible to overfitting, especially with modern deep neural networks. Prior to the introduction of AlexNet, reconstruction-based pretraining with auto-encoder and denoising auto-encoder were found to be beneficial, partially due to the limited size of the training sets at the time. Motivated by these traditional approaches, we propose DiffPT, a simple diffusion modeling approach to pretrain a given classifier backbone for limited domain-specific training data. We experiment on time-series data, standard natural-image benchmarks, and medical imaging datasets, and contrast the diffusion approach to a multitude of modern and traditional un/self-supervised methods. While contrastive pretraining performs better on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet in low-data regimes, DiffPT is particularly effective on medical imaging and time-series tasks, where it outperforms self-supervised baselines across a range of low-data regimes. Our results suggest that DiffPT is a simple and effective approach for data-efficient classifier pretraining on different modalities.
zh_abstract: 在数据有限的情况下，机器学习容易过拟合，尤其是现代深度神经网络。在AlexNet出现之前，使用自编码器和去噪自编码器进行基于重构的预训练被发现有好处，部分原因是当时训练集规模有限。受这些传统方法启发，我们提出DiffPT，一种简单的扩散建模方法，用于在有限的领域特定训练数据上预训练给定的分类器骨干网络。我们在时间序列数据、标准自然图像基准和医学影像数据集上进行实验，并将扩散方法与多种现代和传统的无监督/自监督方法进行对比。尽管对比式预训练在低数据量情形下的CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上表现更好，但DiffPT在医学影像和时间序列任务上尤其有效，在一系列低数据量情形下优于自监督基线。我们的结果表明，DiffPT是一种简单而有效的方法，可用于跨不同模态的数据高效分类器预训练。

title: Input- and Feature-Space Correction for Cross-Hospital IHC Grading
zh_title: 跨医院免疫组化分级输入与特征空间校正
summary: 预印本在12种跨医院迁移设置下，比较冻结病理基础模型前后的无标签校正方法。
key_points: 用UNI与Virchow2作冻结特征提取器
覆盖3种IHC标记与6组有向跨医院迁移
输入空间FIX与特征标准化分别取得最大提升
reason: 预印本系统性跨院基准对比，含外部迁移设置但无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Pathology foundation models (FMs) are trained predominantly on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images but are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for immunohistochemistry (IHC), where cross-hospital differences can impair grading. However, systematic comparisons of correction methods for cross-hospital IHC grading remain limited. To address this gap, we benchmark label-free transformations applied to input images before frozen-FM encoding and to features after frozen-FM encoding using UNI and Virchow2, three IHC markers, and six directed cross-hospital transfers, yielding 12 settings. Among the evaluated input-space methods, our proposed method FIX achieved the largest macro-F1 improvement over no correction, outperforming well-known stain normalization techniques. Among feature-space methods, a simple feature-wise standardization achieved the best improvement over no correction, outperforming CORAL. Under patient-averaged tile-level evaluation, combining FIX with feature-wise standardization improved macro-F1 and quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) by 0.181 and 0.208, respectively, and reduced ordinal error by 0.209 relative to no correction. These results show that input- and feature-space transformations can provide complementary benefits for cross-hospital IHC grading with frozen pathology FMs.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型（FMs）主要使用苏木精-伊红（H&E）图像训练，但越来越多地被用作免疫组织化学（IHC）的冻结特征提取器；在IHC中，跨医院差异可能损害分级。然而，针对跨医院IHC分级校正方法的系统比较仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们使用UNI和Virchow2、三种IHC标志物和六项有向跨医院迁移，产生12种设置，对在冻结FM编码前应用于输入图像以及在冻结FM编码后应用于特征的无标签变换进行基准测试。在评估的输入空间方法中，我们提出的方法FIX相对于无校正取得了最大的macro-F1提升，优于著名的染色归一化技术。在特征空间方法中，简单的逐特征标准化相对于无校正取得了最佳提升，优于CORAL。在按患者平均的瓦片级评估下，将FIX与逐特征标准化结合，相对于无校正分别使macro-F1和二次加权kappa（QWK）提高0.181和0.208，并使有序误差降低0.209。这些结果表明，输入空间和特征空间变换可为使用冻结病理FMs的跨医院IHC分级提供互补益处。

title: MedSTP: Preserving Subspace and Transition Evidence for Medical VQA Token Pruning
zh_title: MedSTP：保留子空间与转移证据的医学VQA token剪枝
summary: 提出免训练的解码前视觉token剪枝方法MedSTP，以子空间稳定性保留医学图像边界与纹理证据。
key_points: 把剪枝视为子空间稳定证据保留问题
用主成分空间估计token谱支持度
引入有界token网格转移先验保护边界纹理
reason: 有新方法并有闭集基准对比，但属预印本且为效率优化，给5分
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) for visual question answering (VQA) often pass long visual-token sequences to the language model, making visual-token pruning attractive but risky for medical images, where answers may depend on localized boundary and texture evidence. We study training free pre-decoding pruning and treat pruning as a subspace stable evidence preservation problem. The retained tokens should remain close to the dominant visual evidence subspace induced by the full token set. To this end, we propose \emph{Subspace-Transition Token Pruning} (\method{}), which estimates each token's spectral support from principal component space and constructs a compact representation subspace. To better reflect medical image structure, \method{} further uses a bounded token-grid transition prior to promote boundary and texture sensitive tokens. We evaluate \method{} on the closed-ended SLAKE and OmniMedVQA benchmarks and on RadImageNet-VQA, which provides both closed-ended and open-ended evaluations, using Lingshu-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones. \method{} delivers consistently strong performance on both the closed-ended and open-ended RadImageNet-VQA evaluations. These results show that \method{} is an effective training free pruning framework for medical domain VQA.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）用于视觉问答（visual question answering, VQA）时，常将长视觉标记序列传递给语言模型，这使得视觉标记剪枝具有吸引力，但对医学图像存在风险，因为答案可能依赖局部边界和纹理证据。我们研究无需训练的解码前剪枝，并将剪枝视为子空间稳定证据保留问题。保留的标记应保持接近由完整标记集诱导的主导视觉证据子空间。为此，我们提出子空间转移标记剪枝（Subspace-Transition Token Pruning，\method{}），其从主成分空间估计每个标记的谱支持，并构建紧凑表示子空间。为更好反映医学图像结构，\method{} 进一步使用有界标记网格转移先验，以促进对边界和纹理敏感的标记。我们在封闭式 SLAKE 和 OmniMedVQA 基准以及 RadImageNet-VQA（提供封闭式和开放式评估）上，使用 Lingshu-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干模型评估 \method{}。\method{} 在 RadImageNet-VQA 的封闭式和开放式评估中均持续表现出强劲性能。这些结果表明，\method{} 是面向医学领域 VQA 的有效无需训练剪枝框架。

title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
zh_title: 合成医疗数据隐私风险实证比较
summary: 在含金丝雀的合成医疗记录上比较数据级与训练级干预的能力—隐私权衡。
key_points: 直接微调能力最佳但隐私泄漏最多
DP-SGD降低泄漏但能力代价显著
隐私感知改写优于简单复述式改写
reason: 受控比较设计清晰，属隐私治理有价值预印本，无外部部署验证
abstract: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information. In this paper, we present a controlled comparison of data-level and training-level interventions for navigating the capability-privacy tradeoff on synthetic medical records with canaries to probe for leakage. Direct finetuning performs best on capability metrics but leads to the most privacy leakage, while DP-SGD reduces leakage at substantial cost to capabilities. Generating synthetic data from these records offers a more favorable balance, particularly when guided by a uniqueness-aware instruction to replace private details. Relative to naive paraphrasing, privacy-aware rewriting improves privacy protection across a variety of different rewriting models. We also find that more capable rewriting models generally reduce the risks of downstream privacy leakage, although held-out fit does not improve monotonically and increased test-time compute yields inconsistent gains. Overall, these results highlight privacy-aware rewriting as a promising direction for achieving a more favorable trade-off between capabilities and empirical privacy compared to other training-level methods, and our evaluation framework supports comparisons of future models and methods.
zh_abstract: 在敏感数据上训练语言模型的方法，在能力提升与泄露私人信息的风险之间如何取得平衡方面存在差异。在本文中，我们针对能力—隐私权衡进行了一项受控比较，比较数据层面与训练层面的干预，所用数据为带有用于探测泄漏的金丝雀（canaries）的合成医疗记录。直接微调在能力指标上表现最好，但导致最多的隐私泄漏；而差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）以能力遭受重大代价为代价减少了泄漏。从这些记录生成合成数据提供了更有利的平衡，尤其是在以唯一性感知指令引导替换私人细节时。相对于简单改写，隐私感知重写在多种不同的重写模型中均改善了隐私保护。我们还发现，能力更强的重写模型总体上降低了下游隐私泄漏的风险，尽管留出集拟合并非单调改善，且增加测试时计算带来的收益并不一致。总体而言，这些结果突出表明，与其他训练层面方法相比，隐私感知重写是实现能力与经验隐私之间更有利权衡的一个有前景的方向，且我们的评估框架支持对未来模型和方法进行比较。

title: Case-Specific Priors-Guided Multimodal Fusion for Prognosis Prediction in Head and Neck Cancer
zh_title: 病例特异性先验引导多模态融合用于头颈癌预后预测
summary: 预印本提出CPM框架，借大模型知识生成病例特异性先验，分三阶段引导临床与病理多模态融合以预测头颈癌预后。
key_points: 以LLM生成病例特异与通用多模态先验
三阶段融合含模态内上下文引导校准
任务为头颈癌预后预测
reason: 有新方法但为预印本、验证范围不明，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate prognosis prediction for head and neck cancer typically necessitates integrating highly heterogeneous clinical and pathological evidence by sophisticated multimodal fusion. However, existing fusion techniques are usually grounded in case-generic clinical rationales about complementary synergies across modalities, underestimating case-specific variance. In this study, we propose a prognosis prediction framework that explicitly incorporates Case-specific Priors to guide Multimodal fusion (named CPM). It leverages broad medical knowledge of LLMs to characterize each case's (case-specific) intra-modal contexts and inter-modal relations, as well as case-generic multimodal rationale, as priors, enabling three-stage priors-guided multimodal fusion: (i) Intra-modal Context-guided Calibration (IntraCC) that leverages case-specific intra-modal priors to guide feature calibration within each modality; (ii) Inter-modal Relation-guided Interaction (InterRI) that leverages case-specific inter-modal priors to guide pair-wise feature interaction in modality pairs; and (iii) Multimodal Rationale-guided Aggregation (MultiRA) that leverages case-generic multimodal priors to guide final feature aggregation over all modalities. On the well-established HANCOCK challenge dataset involving four distinct medical modalities, our CPM achieved a mean AUC of 83.98% for predicting 5-year overall survival and 2-year recurrence-free survival, improving upon the baseline by 7.58%, pioneeringly demonstrating the effectiveness of LLM-derived medical priors in guiding multimodal fusion for prognosis prediction. The code is available at https://github.com/yuelin421/CPM.
zh_abstract: 头颈癌的准确预后预测通常需要通过复杂的多模态融合来整合高度异质的临床和病理证据。然而，现有的融合技术通常基于关于跨模态互补协同的病例通用（case-generic）临床理由，低估了病例特异性变异。在本研究中，我们提出一个预后预测框架，明确纳入病例特异性先验（Case-specific Priors）来指导多模态融合（命名为 CPM）。它利用 LLM 的广泛医学知识来表征每个病例的（病例特异性）模态内上下文和模态间关系，以及病例通用的多模态理由，作为先验，从而实现三阶段先验引导的多模态融合：（i）模态内上下文引导校准（Intra-modal Context-guided Calibration, IntraCC），利用病例特异性模态内先验指导每个模态内的特征校准；（ii）模态间关系引导交互（Inter-modal Relation-guided Interaction, InterRI），利用病例特异性模态间先验指导模态对中的成对特征交互；以及（iii）多模态理由引导聚合（Multimodal Rationale-guided Aggregation, MultiRA），利用病例通用多模态先验指导所有模态上的最终特征聚合。在涉及四种不同医学模态的成熟 HANCOCK 挑战数据集上，我们的 CPM 在预测 5 年总生存和 2 年无复发生存方面达到了平均 AUC 83.98%，比基线提高了 7.58%，开创性地证明了 LLM 衍生的医学先验在指导多模态融合用于预后预测方面的有效性。代码可在 https://github.com/yuelin421/CPM 获取。

abstract: [American journal of lifestyle medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) platforms are becoming increasingly prevalent in healthcare. Unlike previous technologies, AI has the capability to perform tasks previously considered uniquely human including synthesizing historical information and data to establish a clinical diagnosis and constructing a treatment plan. AI promises to improve diagnostic accuracy, accelerate drug discovery and development, and enhance access to healthcare. The overall impact that AI will have on the well-being of individuals who provide and receive care, however, is less obvious. This article examines the potential and pitfalls of AI in medicine through the lens of mattering and its importance to human flourishing. Mattering is a psychological construct that encompasses the human needs to be noticed, feel significant, and contribute. It arises from interpersonal interactions and is based on perceptions of our value within our communities and society. Mattering is inherently relational, is a significant contributor to psychological well-being, and may be at risk in the age of AI. The authors describe the foundations of mattering and its relevance to medicine; the potential impacts of AI on mattering in medicine from the clinician, patient, and trainee perspectives; and propose a framework for integrating AI into healthcare such that mattering is preserved for all stakeholders.
zh_abstract: [American Journal of Lifestyle Medicine] 人工智能（AI）平台在医疗保健中正变得越来越普遍。与以往的技术不同，AI 能够执行此前被认为只有人类才能完成的任务，包括综合历史信息和数据以建立临床诊断并制定治疗方案。AI 有望提高诊断准确性、加速药物发现与开发，并增强医疗服务的可及性。然而，AI 对提供照护和接受照护的个体福祉的整体影响尚不那么明显。本文从被重视感（mattering）及其对人类繁荣的重要性的视角，考察 AI 在医学中的潜力和陷阱。被重视感是一种心理构念，涵盖被注意、感到自身重要并作出贡献的人类需求。它源于人际互动，并基于我们对自身在社区和社会中的价值的感知。被重视感本质上是关系性的，是心理福祉的重要促进因素，并且在 AI 时代可能面临风险。作者描述了被重视感的基础及其与医学的相关性；从临床医生、患者和受训者视角阐述 AI 对医学中被重视感的潜在影响；并提出一个将 AI 整合到医疗保健中的框架，从而使所有利益相关者的被重视感得以保留。
