abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] Machine learning (ML), a subset of artificial intelligence (AI), is revolutionizing health care. Given the intricate anatomy and functional complexity of the hand, AI applications in hand pathology are gaining prominence, particularly in the diagnosis of fractures, nerve injuries, and musculoskeletal disorders. This review summarizes ML advancements in hand pathology diagnosis, enhancing clinical history analysis, examination findings interpretation, and imaging assessment. A systematic search of PubMed, Google Scholar, EMBASE, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus, and Web of Science from 1901 to March 2025 was conducted, focusing on ML applications in diagnosing hand fractures, tendon injuries, and nerve compressions. The inclusion criteria encompassed original research, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and observational studies that demonstrated the use of AI in diagnostic imaging, preoperative assessment, or postoperative management. Studies that did not involve AI-driven diagnostic applications or lacked sufficient methodological transparency were excluded. Machine learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy in detecting fractures. Studies have validated CNNs in the detection of distal radius and ulna fractures, outperforming trainees and urgent care physicians. In addition, AI has enhanced clinical examination by integrating wearable motion sensors for objective joint assessment. However, challenges such as external validation, interpretability, and integration into clinical workflows remain, limiting broader clinical adoption. Machine learning shows promise in hand pathology diagnosis, but widespread adoption requires improved external validation, standardized methods, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Future research should prioritize multicentric studies and explainable AI to enhance trust and integration.
zh_abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] 机器学习（ML）是人工智能（AI）的一个子集，正在彻底改变医疗保健。鉴于手部解剖结构复杂且功能复杂，AI 在手部病理学中的应用日益突出，尤其是在骨折、神经损伤和肌肉骨骼疾病的诊断方面。本综述总结了 ML 在手部病理诊断中的进展，包括增强临床病史分析、检查结果解读和影像评估。我们系统检索了 PubMed、Google Scholar、EMBASE、Cochrane CENTRAL、Scopus 和 Web of Science 从 1901 年至 2025 年 3 月的文献，重点关注 ML 在诊断手部骨折、肌腱损伤和神经卡压中的应用。纳入标准包括展示 AI 用于诊断影像、术前评估或术后管理的原始研究、系统综述、荟萃分析和观察性研究。未涉及 AI 驱动诊断应用或缺乏足够方法学透明度的研究被排除。机器学习模型，特别是卷积神经网络（CNNs），在检测骨折方面已表现出高诊断准确性。研究已验证 CNNs 在检测桡骨远端和尺骨骨折中的表现，优于受训医生和急诊护理医生。此外，AI 通过整合可穿戴运动传感器进行客观关节评估，增强了临床检查。然而，外部验证、可解释性和整合到临床工作流程等挑战仍然存在，限制了更广泛的临床采用。机器学习在手部病理诊断中显示出前景，但广泛采用需要改进外部验证、标准化方法和跨学科合作。未来研究应优先开展多中心研究和可解释 AI，以增强信任和整合。

abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Prostate cancer risk is currently represented by two largely separate genomic layers. Germline polygenic scores estimate inherited susceptibility before diagnosis, whereas tumor genomic and transcriptomic classifiers estimate biological aggressiveness and treatment response after tissue acquisition. Artificial intelligence can connect these layers, but simply concatenating high-dimensional features is unlikely to produce transportable clinical tools. This Mini Review examines how biologically informed machine learning, single-cell and spatial atlases, whole-omics response models, and validated tissue classifiers are reshaping prostate cancer risk stratification. We argue that the most useful architecture is a stage-aware system: ancestry-calibrated germline risk first modifies screening intensity; tissue or liquid-biopsy models then resolve tumor state; and longitudinal molecular measurements update risk under treatment. Evidence is strongest for polygenic enrichment of screening populations and for locked transcriptomic classifiers tested in randomized-trial cohorts. By contrast, many multi-omics models remain retrospective, dataset-dependent, and weakly calibrated across ancestry, disease stage, and specimen type. Progress requires explicit clinical decision points, external and prospective validation, uncertainty reporting, ancestry-aware calibration, and comparisons against simpler clinicopathological models. A unified framework should therefore treat artificial intelligence not as a single prognostic score, but as an auditable sequence of genomic updates that links inherited susceptibility to evolving tumor biology.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] 前列腺癌风险目前由两个在很大程度上相互独立的基因组层面来表示。胚系多基因评分在诊断前估计遗传易感性，而肿瘤基因组和转录组分类器在获取组织后估计生物学侵袭性和治疗反应。人工智能可以连接这些层面，但简单拼接高维特征不太可能产生可移植的临床工具。本小型综述（Mini Review）考察了受生物学启发的机器学习、单细胞和空间图谱、全组学反应模型以及经过验证的组织分类器如何重塑前列腺癌风险分层。我们认为，最有用的架构是一个分期感知系统：首先由经过祖先背景校准的胚系风险调整筛查强度；然后由组织或液体活检模型解析肿瘤状态；纵向分子测量则在治疗过程中更新风险。证据最强的是筛查人群的多基因富集，以及在随机试验队列中测试的锁定转录组分类器。相比之下，许多多组学模型仍是回顾性的、依赖数据集的，并且在 ancestry、疾病分期和标本类型之间的校准较弱。进展需要明确的临床决策点、外部和前瞻性验证、不确定性报告、考虑祖先背景的校准，以及与更简单的临床病理模型进行比较。因此，统一框架应将人工智能视为一个可审计的基因组更新序列，将遗传易感性与不断演变的肿瘤生物学联系起来，而不是视为单一的预后评分。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Perioperative pressure injury (POPI) is a significant global public health challenge, contributing to substantial iatrogenic morbidity and heavy economic burden worldwide. Traditional prevention is limited by insufficient assessment tools, the "black box" nature of intraoperative monitoring, and delayed intervention. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a novel approach by integrating multidimensional data for real-time risk prediction; however, no scoping review has systematically mapped AI applications across the full perioperative continuum from a population health perspective. Systematic searches were conducted in PubMed, Embase, CINAHL, Cochrane Library, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, Web of Science, and Scopus from inception to December 11, 2025. Studies applying machine learning, conventional regression-based benchmarking tools, or intelligent sensor-based monitoring for POPI prediction, monitoring, or prevention during the perioperative period were included. Two reviewers independently performed screening and data extraction, followed by descriptive synthesis and evidence mapping. Six studies (2018-2025), all from East Asia, were included. This geographic concentration highlights an unassessed generalizability and algorithmic fairness risk, rather than an established inequity finding. Evidence concentrated on post-hoc risk stratification (five prediction studies), predominantly using machine learning models (e.g., Random Forest, XGBoost) with AUCs of the best-performing models ranging from 0.806 to 0.836; one study reported a prediction accuracy of 0.9733, which is not directly comparable to AUC. Models identified specialty-specific risk factors (e.g., cardiopulmonary bypass time, forced positioning). Only one proof-of-concept study addressed intraoperative real-time monitoring, visualizing pressure increases after 2 hours of surgery. Evidence for postoperative early warning systems is absent. Current studies demonstrate the feasibility of specialty-specific post-hoc risk stratification using intraoperative covariates, though truly preoperative models remain absent. Intraoperative monitoring shows early promise, but postoperative early warning is a critical gap, and evidence lacks global diversity. Future research should develop closed-loop intelligent systems integrating preoperative prediction, intraoperative multimodal monitoring, and postoperative warning. abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] The study of macromolecular assembly formation is one of the most challenging tasks in computational modeling as it requires extensive exploration of conformational and configurational space, especially when driven by conformational transitions or folding instabilities, which are typically associated with high energy barriers. Although this type of study has traditionally been addressed in silico by using techniques that reduce the computational cost of simulations, such as coarse-grained models, artificial intelligence (AI) has recently entered the field at multiple levels, aiding in parameter optimization or trajectory analysis and even replacing potentials or force calculations. Recently developed algorithms such as AlphaFold (AF) and RoseTTAFold enable the direct prediction of final structures with high efficiency and confidence, an achievement that earned them the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. In this study, we review and analyze the different AI-based strategies used to model protein structure and dynamics and simulate macromolecular assemblies, comparing them with traditional methods, to highlight their respective advantages and limitations. By placing these approaches along an ideal continuum in which accuracy increases as interpretability decreases, we show that hybrid solutions and combinations of methods can be devised to maximize their strengths. Finally, we perspectively outline practical strategies for implementing such integrated approaches in a coherent manner, preserving accuracy and feasibility while maintaining insight into aggregation pathways, intermediate structures, and the molecular mechanisms underlying the phenomenon.
zh_abstract: 《Frontiers in Molecular Biosciences》大分子组装形成的研究是计算建模中最具挑战性的任务之一，因为它需要对构象空间和构型空间进行广泛探索，尤其是当由构象转变或折叠不稳定性驱动时，而这些通常与高能垒相关。尽管此类研究传统上通过在计算机模拟中使用降低模拟计算成本的技术（如粗粒化模型）来处理，但人工智能（AI）近年来已在多个层面进入该领域，辅助参数优化或轨迹分析，甚至替代势能或力计算。最近开发的算法如AlphaFold（AF）和RoseTTAFold能够以高效率和置信度直接预测最终结构，这一成就使它们获得了2024年诺贝尔化学奖。在本研究中，我们回顾并分析用于建模蛋白质结构与动力学以及模拟大分子组装体的不同基于AI的策略，并将其与传统方法进行比较，以突出各自的优势和局限性。通过将这些方法置于一个理想连续体上——在该连续体中，准确性随可解释性降低而提高——我们表明可以设计混合解决方案和方法组合，以最大化其优势。最后，我们从前景角度概述以连贯方式实施此类整合方法的实用策略，在保持准确性和可行性的同时，维持对聚集途径、中间结构以及该现象背后分子机制的洞察。

abstract: [Extracellular vesicles and circulating nucleic acids] Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are promising platforms for next-generation drug delivery and regenerative therapeutics, yet biological heterogeneity, limited targeting specificity, variable cargo composition, and continued reliance on empirical optimization hinder clinical translation. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities to make EV engineering more predictive and data-driven. Building on prior work in AI-assisted EV delivery and emerging virtual-EV modeling, this review presents an evidence-aware, multiscale framework that integrates parental-cell programming, vesicle design, recipient-system modeling, and experimental feedback. At the source level, AI virtual cells (AIVCs) may help predict how perturbations to parental cells influence EV biogenesis and composition. At the vesicle level, AI-guided approaches may support cargo prioritization, surface engineering, and loading optimization. At the recipient level, digital twin models could help simulate EV uptake, intracellular trafficking, microenvironmental interactions, and downstream therapeutic responses. These components may ultimately be integrated with experimental validation into iterative design-test-refinement workflows. Importantly, this review distinguishes direct EV-specific evidence from technologies transferable from adjacent fields and concepts that remain prospective. By defining these evidence boundaries and linking them to key challenges in data quality, model interpretability, manufacturing, and validation, this framework provides a practical roadmap for advancing AI-enabled EV therapeutics from conceptual modeling to testable, translationally relevant engineering strategies.
zh_abstract: [细胞外囊泡与循环核酸] 细胞外囊泡（extracellular vesicles, EVs）是下一代药物递送和再生治疗的有前景平台，但其生物学异质性、靶向特异性有限、货物组成可变以及对经验性优化的持续依赖，阻碍了临床转化。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）为使 EV 工程更具预测性和数据驱动性提供了新机会。基于此前在 AI 辅助 EV 递送和新兴虚拟 EV 建模方面的工作，本综述提出了一个证据感知的多尺度框架，整合亲本细胞编程、囊泡设计、受体系统建模和实验反馈。在来源层面，AI 虚拟细胞（AI virtual cells, AIVCs）可能有助于预测对亲本细胞的扰动如何影响 EV 的生物发生和组成。在囊泡层面，AI 引导的方法可能支持货物优先级排序、表面工程和装载优化。在受体层面，数字孪生模型可能有助于模拟 EV 摄取、细胞内运输、微环境相互作用和下游治疗反应。这些组成部分最终可能与实验验证整合为迭代的设计-测试-优化工作流程。重要的是，本综述区分了直接的 EV 特异性证据、可从相邻领域迁移的技术以及仍属前瞻性的概念。通过界定这些证据边界并将其与数据质量、模型可解释性、制造和验证中的关键挑战联系起来，该框架为将 AI 赋能的 EV 治疗从概念建模推进到可测试、具有转化相关性的工程策略提供了实用路线图。

title: AI, libraries, and literacy: revisiting the Journal of the Medical Library Association's policy on the use of generative artificial intelligence in submissions.
source: PubMed · Journal of the Medical Library Association : JMLA

summary: 期刊回顾其生成式AI投稿政策三年实践，讨论认知外包、幻觉引用等教育与研究挑战。

reason: 期刊政策类述评，无实证数据，属增量信息
abstract: [Journal of the Medical Library Association : JMLA] In the fall of 2023, the Journal of the Medical Library Association (JMLA) introduced its policy on generative artificial intelligence (AI) submissions, predicting that these tools would become embedded within the workflows of clinicians, educators, researchers, and students. Those predictions dramatically underestimated AI's impact. On the three-year anniversary of that editorial, we revisit the issue in light of AI's unprecedentedly rapid adoption across knowledge work. We examine the educational challenges AI poses, arguing that excessive cognitive offloading threatens the deep thinking on which learning depends. We then consider the challenges AI creates for researchers, from hallucinated citations to fabricated diseases. We suggest that health sciences librarians, who offer expertise in approaching information systems with discernment, are well suited to be leaders in this space. To help prospective JMLA authors weigh whether and when to use AI, we propose the Compliance, Verifiability, and Disclosure (CVD) Framework. Throughout, we reaffirm our conviction that education and research must remain human-centered endeavors.
zh_abstract: 《医学图书馆协会杂志：JMLA》（Journal of the Medical Library Association : JMLA）2023年秋季，《医学图书馆协会杂志》（JMLA）推出了其关于生成式人工智能（AI）投稿的政策，预测这些工具将嵌入临床医生、教育工作者、研究人员和学生的工作流程中。这些预测极大地低估了AI的影响。在该社论发表三周年之际，鉴于AI在知识工作中前所未有的快速采用，我们重新审视这一问题。我们考察AI带来的教育挑战，认为过度的认知卸载威胁到学习所依赖的深度思考。随后，我们思考AI为研究人员带来的挑战，从幻觉引文到虚构疾病。我们认为，健康科学图书馆员具备以辨别力处理信息系统的专业知识，适合成为该领域的领导者。为帮助潜在的JMLA作者权衡是否以及何时使用AI，我们提出“合规、可验证与披露”（Compliance, Verifiability, and Disclosure, CVD）框架。全文始终重申我们的信念：教育和研究必须仍是以人为本的事业。

abstract: [Surgery] The operating room is a high-risk, high-entropy environment, prone to human error and preventable adverse events. Drawing on lessons from high-reliability organizations such as the aviation industry, Aimbient (formerly Operating Room Black Box by Surgical Safety Technologies, New York, NY) collects continuous, multimodal audiovisual and physiologic data capture to deepen our understanding of surgical safety. This platform has demonstrated improvements in patient safety domains across several metrics, including ground-truth benchmarking of checklist adherence, video-based multidisciplinary review conferences, and automated physiologic event tagging. Recent integration of key postoperative morbidity and mortality metrics into the data streams collected by Aimbient monitoring platforms allows for us to achieve a holistic understanding of the perioperative record. As artificial intelligence capabilities rapidly expand and begin to integrate into our health care systems, ambient data capture is uniquely poised to generate real-time insights and open new frontiers in surgical patient safety.
zh_abstract: [Surgery] 手术室是一个高风险、高熵的环境，容易发生人为错误和可预防的不良事件。借鉴航空业等高可靠性组织的经验，Aimbient（原为 Surgical Safety Technologies 的 Operating Room Black Box，纽约州纽约市）采集连续、多模态的音视频和生理数据，以加深我们对手术安全的理解。该平台已在多个指标上显示出患者安全领域的改善，包括清单依从性的真实基准评测、基于视频的多学科审查会议以及自动生理事件标记。近期将关键的术后发病率和死亡率指标整合到 Aimbient 监测平台所采集的数据流中，使我们能够对围手术期记录形成整体理解。随着人工智能能力迅速扩展并开始整合到我们的医疗保健系统中，环境数据采集具有独特优势，可以生成实时见解并开辟手术患者安全的新前沿。

title: TransNSNet: A Transformer-Enhanced Multi-Scale Adversarial Framework for CT-to-PET Image Synthesis
zh_title: TransNSNet：Transformer 增强的 CT 到 PET 图像合成框架
summary: 预印本提出多尺度对抗框架，用公开 NSCLC 队列做 CT 转 PET 合成，图像指标多数优于基线。
key_points: 基于公开 NSCLC 影像基因组学数据配对 CT-PET
多尺度生成并引入 TransPatchGAN 上下文交互
十项指标中九项均值最优，但仅单次训练
reason: 单数据集、单次训练、无外部验证的预印本方法，属增量档
abstract: This study investigates CT-to-PET image synthesis using TransNSNet, a Transformer-enhanced multi-scale adversarial framework. A paired CT-PET dataset was curated from the public non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) Radiogenomics collection through patient screening, slice-level matching, preprocessing, and patient-level train-test separation. The proposed framework generates PET-like predictions at multiple spatial scales and applies coarse-to-fine reconstruction supervision, while TransPatchGAN introduces contextual feature interaction into adversarial evaluation. A progressive ablation study compares Pix2Pix, NSNet-Base, NSNet-D, and TransNSNet. Image-level performance was summarized over a fixed convergence window (epochs 80-101) from one training run per model. TransNSNet achieved the best mean value in nine of ten metrics, whereas NSNet-Base achieved the highest visual saliency-induced index. For fixed-fraction high-intensity regions, NSNet-D was marginally higher in slice-level recall and balanced accuracy, but the equal-weight patient-level values were nearly identical and the highest Dice values shifted to TransNSNet. These differences were small relative to between-patient variability. In the separate adaptive patient-level analysis (n=10), no pairwise model difference remained statistically significant after Holm correction. TransNSNet also had a substantially smaller parameter footprint than the original next-scale models. These findings indicate promising image-quality trends, but they do not establish statistical superiority or clinical validity; synthesized PET-like images should not be interpreted as substitutes for clinically acquired PET.
zh_abstract: 本研究使用 TransNSNet——一个 Transformer 增强的多尺度对抗框架——研究 CT 到 PET 的图像合成。通过患者筛选、切片级匹配、预处理以及患者级训练-测试分离，从公共非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）放射基因组学数据集中整理出配对 CT-PET 数据集。所提出的框架在多个空间尺度上生成类 PET 预测，并应用由粗到细的重建监督，同时 TransPatchGAN 将上下文特征交互引入对抗评估。一项渐进式消融研究比较了 Pix2Pix、NSNet-Base、NSNet-D 和 TransNSNet。图像级性能在固定收敛窗口（第 80–101 个 epoch）内、基于每个模型一次训练运行的结果进行汇总。TransNSNet 在十项指标中的九项取得最佳平均值，而 NSNet-Base 取得最高的视觉显著性诱导指数。对于固定比例的高强度区域，NSNet-D 在切片级召回率和平衡准确率上略高，但等权重的患者级数值几乎相同，且最高 Dice 值转向 TransNSNet。相对于患者间变异性，这些差异较小。在单独的自适应患者级分析（n=10）中，经 Holm 校正后，任何模型间成对差异均不再具有统计学显著性。TransNSNet 的参数占用量也显著小于原始 next-scale 模型。这些发现表明图像质量趋势有希望，但并未确立统计学优效性或临床有效性；合成的类 PET 图像不应被解释为临床采集 PET 的替代物。

title: Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT): Evidence-Based Text Generation via a Closed-Loop Retrieve--Reflect--Revise Pipeline on Edge LLMs
zh_title: 自反思思维链SRCoT：边缘LLM检索-反思-修订闭环
summary: 提出模块化SRCoT架构，将生成组织为检索-反思-修订闭环，并在急救医疗等两个全合成场景做定性案例分析。
key_points: 分离环境状态、知识、经验与短期记忆并可溯源
BM25检索提供本地上下文，多轮暴露草稿与证据映射
仅在两处全合成场景做定性轨迹案例研究
reason: 方法有新意但仅合成场景定性案例，无定量对比，属增量档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent outputs that lack source support or conflict with local operational constraints. We introduce Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT), a modular architecture that organizes generation as a closed Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop. SRCoT separates environment state, persistent knowledge, accumulated experience, and short-term memory into provenance-labeled stores. BM25 retrieval supplies local context; subsequent passes expose intermediate drafts, missing-information markers, follow-up queries, and optional claim--evidence mappings. These artifacts inform retrieval, revision, clarification, or abstention decisions. We examine the architecture through qualitative, trace-based case studies in two fully synthetic settings: emergency medical services and Munich-Sim, an emergency-operations simulation. Local prototype runs on an Apple M4-family laptop with 128 GB memory illustrate source-labeled documentation, explicit gap marking, and structured dispatch-style outputs. The traces also reveal provenance-assignment errors, incomplete evidence coverage, and unsafe assumptions that remain possible despite prompting constraints. These cases demonstrate report-level inspectability and local execution, not comparative superiority, hallucination reduction, clinical validity, or operational safety. The architecture separates retrieval and control from the model interface, but behavior across different models remains to be evaluated. SRCoT is a research proof of concept requiring human review, with its principal contribution lying in an inspectable control procedure rather than a new model.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）可以生成流畅但缺乏来源支持或与本地操作约束相冲突的输出。我们引入自我反思思维链（Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought，SRCoT），一种模块化架构，将生成组织为封闭的检索—反思—修订（Retrieve--Reflect--Revise）循环。SRCoT 将环境状态、持久知识、积累经验和短期记忆分离到带有来源标记的存储中。BM25 检索提供本地上下文；后续轮次暴露中间草稿、缺失信息标记、后续查询以及可选的主张—证据映射。这些产物为检索、修订、澄清或弃权决策提供信息。我们通过两个完全合成场景中的定性、基于轨迹的案例研究来考察该架构：紧急医疗服务（emergency medical services）和 Munich-Sim，一个紧急行动模拟。在配备 128 GB 内存的 Apple M4 系列笔记本电脑上运行的本地原型展示了带来源标记的文档记录、明确的缺口标记和结构化的调度式输出。轨迹还揭示了来源分配错误、证据覆盖不完整以及不安全假设，这些尽管有提示约束仍可能发生。这些案例展示了报告级别的可检查性和本地执行，而非比较优越性、幻觉减少、临床有效性或操作安全性。该架构将检索和控制与模型接口分离，但不同模型间的行为仍有待评估。SRCoT 是一个需要人工审核的研究概念验证，其主要贡献在于可检查的控制程序，而非新模型。

title: Really Need Recursion? Revisiting One-pass Registration with Multi-level Multi-space Contextual Guidance
zh_title: 单次形变配准的多级多空间上下文引导
summary: 预印本提出M2CG单次配准网络，用多级多空间上下文引导替代递归迭代。
key_points: 质疑高性能形变配准是否必须递归
单次迭代内完成多步渐进金字塔配准
每步引入前中后三级、四个空间的上下文
reason: 预印本方法改进，聚焦效率与精度，缺外部临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Deformable image registration is a fundamental challenge in medical image analysis. Recent deep learning-based methods typically adopt either one-pass architectures that complete registration in a single network iteration, or recursive architectures that refine registration through multiple passes. While recursive methods often improve accuracy, they incur substantial computational overhead and slower inference speed. In this paper, we challenge the necessity of recursion for high-performance deformable registration and propose M2CG, a one-pass registration network with Multi-level Multi-space Contextual Guidance. It performs multi-step progressive pyramid registration within a single iteration, guided at each step by contextual cues from three levels (previous, current, and subsequent steps) and four spaces (image space, image feature space, segmentation space, and segmentation feature space). Our M2CG supports both unsupervised (without any labels) and semi-supervised (with segmentation labels for partial training data) registration, and has achieved state-of-the-art performance across two well-benchmarked inter-/intra-patient medical registration tasks with eight public datasets. Our findings suggest that the current reliance on recursion may stem from the absence of sufficient contextual cues that comprehensively characterize the remaining distance to the target alignment.
zh_abstract: 可变形图像配准是医学图像分析中的一个基本挑战。近期基于深度学习的方法通常采用单次架构（在一次网络迭代中完成配准）或递归架构（通过多次传递细化配准）。虽然递归方法通常提高准确性，但会带来大量计算开销和更慢的推理速度。在本文中，我们质疑高性能可变形配准中递归的必要性，并提出 M2CG，一种具有多级多空间上下文引导（Multi-level Multi-space Contextual Guidance）的单次配准网络。它在一次迭代内执行多步渐进式金字塔配准，每一步由来自三个层级（前一步、当前步和后续步）和四个空间（图像空间、图像特征空间、分割空间和分割特征空间）的上下文线索引导。我们的 M2CG 支持无监督（无任何标签）和半监督（部分训练数据带有分割标签）配准，并在两个具有良好基准的、涵盖八项公开数据集的患者间/患者内医学配准任务上取得了最先进的性能。我们的发现表明，当前对递归的依赖可能源于缺乏足够的上下文线索，这些线索能够全面表征与目标对齐之间的剩余距离。
